literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: The supplied evidence does not report any observed results, such as sample counts, percentages, effect sizes, P values, or confidence intervals. [10.1111/jdv.70864]

During a median follow-up period of 6.3 years, five patients developed HCC. Patients who subsequently developed HCC had significantly higher post-treatment ATX levels than those who did not (1.32 vs. 0.84 mg/L, P = 0.010). [10.2169/internalmedicine.8073-26]

Six LSM phenotypes showed marked prognostic separation, with 9-year LRE incidence ranging from 1.3 to 63.1% (p < 0.001). Each 20% increase in updated LSM was associated with LREs (adjusted HR 1.37, 95% CI 1.29-1.46), hepatic decompensation (1.55, 1.43-1.68), and HCC (1.23, 1.14-1.33). [10.1007/s12072-026-11175-4]
The updated guidelines emphasize a more comprehensive evaluation of HBV infection, incorporating factors beyond HBeAg, HBV DNA, and ALT to guide treatment decisions. [10.7326/annals-26-04729-im]

After a median follow-up of 9.4 years, 35 (8.4%) of 415 PWH achieved HBsAg seroclearance during a total of 3600 person-years of tenofovir-containing ART, corresponding to an incidence rate of 0.97 per 100 person-years. Among them, 37.1% (13/35) tested positive for anti-HBs at the time of seroclearance. [10.1093/cid/ciag429]

news.headline_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期乙型肝炎病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 在改用含有卡博特韦/利匹韦林的 治疗 注射方案后,在一些个体中观察到乙型肝炎重新激活。国际艾滋病毒感染药物治疗大会(HIV 格拉斯哥 2026)上发表的研究报告了这一点。 [news-129b0f7c281498bb]
北京大学和中国合作医院的研究人员开发并验证了一种简化的 GADA 模型,用于检测 HBV 相关肝细胞癌 (HCC)。该模型是为患有 HBV 相关慢性肝病的患者设计的,并在三个 队列研究 中进行了测试:建模、内部验证和外部验证。 [news-0932e2541ef9ad28]
一项多中心研究验证了 GADA 模型,这是一种简化的四变量统计工具,旨在检测 慢性乙型肝炎 病毒感染患者的肝细胞癌。该模型由北京大学和合作临床中心的研究人员开发。 [news-71092778f79cf499]
该报告对 慢性乙型肝炎 市场进行了分析,包括其增长趋势、关键因素和未来预测。它还引用了 2022 年报告的新 HBV 感染人数。 [news-57d267ae7916efcd]
一项研究发现 乙型肝炎病毒 感染与肺癌风险增加之间存在显着关联,其中在东亚人群中观察到的相关性最强。该研究由 Bioengineer.org 报道。 [news-2856a82c85fc7382]
news.trend_or_risk_zh: 风险判断仅依据入选来源已经确认的信息，不把媒体推测升级为官方结论。
news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Hepatitis B virus news developments.
key_findings_en: Hepatitis B reactivation was observed in some individuals after switching to injectable treatment regimens containing cabotegravir / rilpivirine. This was reported by studies presented at the International Congress on Drug Therapy in HIV Infection (HIV Glasgow 2026). [news-129b0f7c281498bb]

Researchers from Peking University and collaborating hospitals in China developed and validated a simplified GADA model for detecting HBV-related hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). [news-0932e2541ef9ad28]

A multicenter investigation validated the GADA model, a simplified four-variable statistical tool designed to detect hepatocellular carcinoma in patients with chronic hepatitis B virus infection. The model was developed by researchers from Peking University and collaborating clinical centers. [news-71092778f79cf499]

The report provides an analysis of the chronic hepatitis B market, including its growth trends, key factors, and future projections. It also references the number of new HBV infections reported in 2022. [news-57d267ae7916efcd]

A study found a significant association between hepatitis B virus infection and an increased risk of lung cancer, with the strongest correlation observed in East Asian populations. The study was reported by Bioengineer.org. [news-2856a82c85fc7382]

papers.title: The Safety, Pharmacokinetics, and Antiviral Activity of ABI-4334, A Novel Next-Generation Hepatitis B Capsid Assembly Modulator.
papers.abstract: Novel, well-tolerated, short-term therapeutics for chronic hepatitis B virus infection (cHBV) are needed. ABI-4334 is a next-generation capsid assembly modulator that targets the HBV core protein. The safety, tolerability, and pharmacokinetics of ABI-4334 in healthy volunteers and participants with cHBV and antiviral effects in participants with cHBV were examined in two Phase 1 studies. Study 101 was a placebo-controlled study of healthy volunteers that included four single-ascending dose cohorts and two once-daily multiple-ascending dose cohorts randomized 6:2 (ABI-4334:placebo), and one crossover food-effect cohort randomized 3:3 (fed:fasted). Study 102 was a randomized, blinded, placebo-controlled study where participants with cHBV were randomized 8:2 (ABI-4334 [2 dose cohorts]:placebo). Overall, 54 healthy volunteers and 20 participants with cHBV were included in Studies 101 and 102, respectively. Most participants (75%) in Study 102 were hepatitis B e antigen (HBeAg) negative and generally had lower baseline HBV DNA and pregenomic RNA (pgRNA) levels. ABI-4334 was well tolerated, with no treatment-emergent serious adverse events (AEs) or treatment-emergent AEs leading to study discontinuation. The mean ABI-4334 plasma half-life ranges were comparable across doses in both studies. Following multiple-dose administration in participants with cHBV, the steady-state mean plasma half-life ranged from 17.5 to 27.5 h. HBV DNA declines were observed in both HBeAg-positive (n = 3) and -negative (n = 13) participants across doses. Reductions in pgRNA were observed in participants with detectable pgRNA at baseline. ABI-4334 was well tolerated, with pharmacokinetics and antiviral results supporting the continued development of ABI-4334 as a monotherapy or component of novel combination regimens for cHBV. Trial Registration: Study 101 (NCT05569941). Study 102 (NCT06384131).

papers.title: Hepatitis B and D: Interferon-Based Therapy-For Clinical Trials or Standard of Care-Back to the Future?
papers.abstract: Interferon (IFN) has historically played a major role in chronic viral hepatitis B and D management over the last three decades. Widening utilisation of nucleoside/nucleotide analogues (NUCs) for hepatitis B viral suppression, which have a better side-effect profile, alongside the recent licensing of bulevirtide for treatment of hepatitis D, means that its clinical use has further declined. Pegylated-interferon alpha (peg-IFNα) treatment is suboptimal with poor tolerability and achieves durable clearance of hepatitis B and D in only a limited number of patients. Nevertheless, its use in hepatitis B has significantly increased the number of patients achieving hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) loss compared to those on NUCs alone. Evidence has shown that peg-IFNα is also associated with overall improved long-term clinical outcomes in chronic hepatitis D, even for the many whose hepatitis D viral load rebounds after discontinuation. Clinical trials have recently focused on peg-IFNα in combination with novel antiviral therapies in the goal for finite cure in hepatitis B and D. This article focuses on recent research advances, examining if peg-IFNα treatment may still play an important role in hepatitis B and D treatment.

analysis.scope_and_question: Interferon (IFN) has historically played a major role in chronic viral hepatitis B and D management over the last three decades.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: Widening utilisation of nucleoside/nucleotide analogues (NUCs) for hepatitis B viral suppression, which have a better side-effect profile, alongside the recent licensing of bulevirtide for treatment of hepatitis D, means that its clinical use has further declined.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Pegylated-interferon alpha (peg-IFNα) treatment is suboptimal with poor tolerability and achieves durable clearance of hepatitis B and D in only a limited number of patients.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: Nevertheless, its use in hepatitis B has significantly increased the number of patients achieving hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) loss compared to those on NUCs alone.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Evidence has shown that peg-IFNα is also associated with overall improved long-term clinical outcomes in chronic hepatitis D, even for the many whose hepatitis D viral load rebounds after discontinuation.

analysis.summary_en: This review examines the historical and current role of interferon-based therapy in managing hepatitis B and D. It highlights the decline in clinical use due to the availability of nucleoside/nucleotide analogues (NUCs) and bulevirtide, which offer better side-effect profiles. Pegylated-interferon alpha (peg-IFNα) is noted as suboptimal with poor tolerability and limited durable clearance rates. However, its use in hepatitis B has increased HBsAg loss compared to NUCs alone. Additionally, peg-IFNα is associated with improved long-term clinical outcomes in chronic hepatitis D, despite viral load rebounds post-treatment. The review focuses on recent research advances and the potential for peg-IFNα to still play an important role in treatment strategies.

papers.title_zh: 乙型和丁型肝炎:基于干扰素的治疗 - 用于临床试验或标准护理 - 回到未来?
papers.source_body_en: Interferon (IFN) has historically played a major role in chronic viral hepatitis B and D management over the last three decades. Widening utilisation of nucleoside/nucleotide analogues (NUCs) for hepatitis B viral suppression, which have a better side-effect profile, alongside the recent licensing of bulevirtide for treatment of hepatitis D, means that its clinical use has further declined. Pegylated-interferon alpha (peg-IFNα) treatment is suboptimal with poor tolerability and achieves durable clearance of hepatitis B and D in only a limited number of patients. Nevertheless, its use in hepatitis B has significantly increased the number of patients achieving hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) loss compared to those on NUCs alone. Evidence has shown that peg-IFNα is also associated with overall improved long-term clinical outcomes in chronic hepatitis D, even for the many whose hepatitis D viral load rebounds after discontinuation. Clinical trials have recently focused on peg-IFNα in combination with novel antiviral therapies in the goal for finite cure in hepatitis B and D. This article focuses on recent research advances, examining if peg-IFNα treatment may still play an important role in hepatitis B and D treatment.
papers.abstract_zh: 过去三十年来,干扰素 (IFN) 在慢性病毒性乙型肝炎和丁型肝炎的治疗中发挥了重要作用。核苷/核苷酸类似物(NUC)在抑制乙型肝炎病毒方面的广泛应用(其副作用较小),加上最近获得的用于丁型肝炎 治疗 的 bulevirtide 许可,意味着其临床使用进一步下降。聚乙二醇化干扰素α (peg-IFNα) 治疗 效果欠佳,耐受性差,仅在有限数量的患者中实现了乙型肝炎和丁型肝炎的持久清除。尽管如此,与单独使用 NUC 的患者相比,其在乙型肝炎中的使用显着增加了实现乙型肝炎表面抗原 (HBsAg) 消失的患者数量。有证据表明,peg-IFNα 还与慢性丁型肝炎的长期临床结果的整体改善相关,即使对于许多丁型肝炎病毒载量在停药后反弹的人来说也是如此。最近的临床试验重点关注 peg-IFNα 与新型 抗病毒药物 疗法的联合治疗,以实现乙型肝炎和丁型肝炎的有限治愈。本文重点介绍最新的研究进展,探讨 peg-IFNα 治疗 是否仍可能在乙型肝炎和丁型肝炎 治疗 中发挥重要作用。

papers.title: Chronic Hepatitis B in the United States: Current Landscape, Unmet Needs and Future Directions.
papers.abstract: Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) infection represents a major public health challenge in the US, with substantial unmet needs related to timely diagnosis, treatment, monitoring and disease management. This narrative review explores the CHB landscape in the US, including gaps in patient care, the evolving therapeutic landscape, the clinical utility of serological biomarkers to improve outcomes and the experiences of people living with hepatitis B (PLWHB). Hepatitis B remains underdiagnosed and undertreated in the US, and current efforts are insufficient to meet the associated World Health Organization 2030 elimination targets. Latest guidelines from the American Association for the Study of Liver Diseases and the Infectious Diseases Society of America, representing a North American perspective, signify a shift towards expanded treatment eligibility criteria and shared decision-making. Nucleos(t)ide analogues (NAs) are the current standard of care in the US, but functional cure is rarely achieved with NAs alone. Novel finite therapies targeting functional cure, such as antisense oligonucleotides, small interfering RNAs, immune modulators and combination or sequential regimens, are under investigation. Because of the unpredictable, complex nature of CHB, biomarkers such as quantitative hepatitis B surface antigen offer prognostic value for treatment decisions and could help guide individualised CHB management. PLWHB experience psychological impacts and health-related concerns, including fear of transmission and hepatitis B virus-related complications. Opportunities for improvement of CHB management include increased screening and linkage to care, development of more treatments targeting functional cure, adoption of serological biomarkers to inform treatment decisions and prioritising the lived experiences and preferences of PLWHB.

analysis.summary_en: This review highlights the significant public health challenge posed by chronic hepatitis B (CHB) in the United States, emphasizing the need for improved diagnosis, treatment, and disease management. The review outlines the current landscape of CHB, noting that it remains underdiagnosed and undertreated, with insufficient progress towards meeting WHO 2030 elimination targets. It discusses the limitations of nucleos(t)ide analogues (NAs) in achieving a functional cure and highlights the potential of novel therapies and serological biomarkers to improve outcomes. The review also underscores the importance of incorporating the lived experiences and preferences of people living with hepatitis B (PLWHB) into management strategies. These findings suggest a need for expanded treatment eligibility, shared decision-making, and further research into more effective therapeutic approaches.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 感染是美国的一项重大公共卫生挑战,与及时 诊断、治疗、监测和疾病管理相关的大量需求未得到满足。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 这篇叙述性综述探讨了美国慢性乙型肝炎的情况,包括患者护理方面的差距、不断发展的治疗前景、血清学生物标志物在改善乙型肝炎患者 (PLWHB) 患者的治疗结果和经历方面的临床效用。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 在美国,乙型肝炎的诊断和治疗仍然不足,目前的努力不足以实现世界卫生组织相关的 2030 年消除目标。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 改善 CHB 管理的机会包括增加筛查和与护理的联系、开发更多针对 功能性治愈 的 治疗、采用血清学生物标志物来告知 治疗 决策以及优先考虑 PLWHB 的生活经历和偏好。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 由于慢性乙型肝炎的不可预测性和复杂性,定量乙型肝炎表面抗原等生物标志物可为 治疗 决策提供预后价值,并有助于指导个体化慢性乙型肝炎管理。

papers.title_zh: 美国的 慢性乙型肝炎:当前形势、未满足的需求和未来方向。
papers.source_body_en: Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) infection represents a major public health challenge in the US, with substantial unmet needs related to timely diagnosis, treatment, monitoring and disease management. This narrative review explores the CHB landscape in the US, including gaps in patient care, the evolving therapeutic landscape, the clinical utility of serological biomarkers to improve outcomes and the experiences of people living with hepatitis B (PLWHB). Hepatitis B remains underdiagnosed and undertreated in the US, and current efforts are insufficient to meet the associated World Health Organization 2030 elimination targets. Latest guidelines from the American Association for the Study of Liver Diseases and the Infectious Diseases Society of America, representing a North American perspective, signify a shift towards expanded treatment eligibility criteria and shared decision-making. Nucleos(t)ide analogues (NAs) are the current standard of care in the US, but functional cure is rarely achieved with NAs alone. Novel finite therapies targeting functional cure, such as antisense oligonucleotides, small interfering RNAs, immune modulators and combination or sequential regimens, are under investigation. Because of the unpredictable, complex nature of CHB, biomarkers such as quantitative hepatitis B surface antigen offer prognostic value for treatment decisions and could help guide individualised CHB management. PLWHB experience psychological impacts and health-related concerns, including fear of transmission and hepatitis B virus-related complications. Opportunities for improvement of CHB management include increased screening and linkage to care, development of more treatments targeting functional cure, adoption of serological biomarkers to inform treatment decisions and prioritising the lived experiences and preferences of PLWHB.
papers.abstract_zh: 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 感染是美国的一项重大公共卫生挑战,与及时 诊断、治疗、监测和疾病管理相关的大量需求未得到满足。这篇叙述性综述探讨了美国慢性乙型肝炎的情况,包括患者护理方面的差距、不断发展的治疗前景、血清学生物标志物在改善乙型肝炎患者 (PLWHB) 患者的治疗结果和经历方面的临床效用。在美国,乙型肝炎的诊断和治疗仍然不足,目前的努力不足以实现世界卫生组织相关的 2030 年消除目标。美国肝病研究协会和美国传染病学会的最新指南代表了北美的观点,标志着向扩大 治疗 资格标准和共同决策的转变。核苷(酸)类似物 (NA) 是美国目前的护理标准,但单独使用 NA 很少能实现 功能性治愈。针对 功能性治愈 的新型有限疗法,例如反义寡核苷酸、小干扰 RNA、免疫调节剂以及组合或序贯疗法,正在研究中。由于慢性乙型肝炎的不可预测性和复杂性,定量乙型肝炎表面抗原等生物标志物可为 治疗 决策提供预后价值,并有助于指导个体化慢性乙型肝炎管理。PLWHB 经历心理影响和健康相关问题,包括对 传播 和 乙型肝炎病毒 相关并发症的恐惧。改善 CHB 管理的机会包括增加筛查和与护理的联系、开发更多针对 功能性治愈 的 治疗、采用血清学生物标志物来告知 治疗 决策以及优先考虑 PLWHB 的生活经历和偏好。

analysis.study_design_and_population: This is a correction to a previously published population-based spatial analysis conducted in Alberta, focusing on the geospatial distribution of hepatitis B and D testing across the region.

analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings are significant for improving the accuracy of spatial analyses in public health, which can inform targeted testing strategies and resource allocation in regions with similar geospatial challenges.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is limited to a correction of figures, which does not provide new data but ensures the integrity of the original study's spatial analysis. The confidence in the corrected figures is high.

The correct figures are now provided, ensuring the spatial analysis accurately reflects the testing patterns. The correction is important for maintaining the integrity of the data and informing targeted testing strategies. The evidence is limited to the correction itself, and the confidence in the corrected figures is high.

analysis_zh.main_results: 图2被错误地标记为显示慢性乙型肝炎和患病率的热点分析,而实际上应显示抗丁型肝炎病毒(anti-HDV)检测。同样,图3被错误地标记为显示抗丁型肝炎病毒(anti-HDV)检测,而应代表抗丁型肝炎病毒阳性(anti-HDV positivity)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该更正明确了数据的准确表示,确保空间分析正确反映乙型肝炎病毒和丁型肝炎病毒的检测模式,其新颖之处在于特别关注阿尔伯塔省的空间差异。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现对于提高公共卫生领域空间分析的准确性具有重要意义,可以为具有类似空间挑战的地区提供有针对性的检测策略和资源分配的依据。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据仅限于图表的更正,这并未提供新的数据,但确保了原始研究空间分析的完整性。更正后的图表具有高度的可信度。

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addresses the need to update treatment decisions for hepatitis B virus (HBV) based on laboratory criteria alone, highlighting a gap in current practices that rely on traditional markers such as HBeAg, HBV DNA, and ALT.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a guideline update presented at IDWeek 2026 in Washington, D.C., focusing on human hepatitis B virus infection and its associated disease states, including chronic and acute hepatitis B, HBV-related cirrhosis, and hepatocellular carcinoma.
analysis.methods: The methods involve reviewing updated guidelines from the American Association for the Study of Liver Diseases and the Infectious Diseases Society of America, which incorporate a broader approach to treatment decisions by considering additional factors beyond traditional laboratory criteria.
analysis.main_results: The updated guidelines emphasize a more comprehensive evaluation of HBV infection, incorporating factors beyond HBeAg, HBV DNA, and ALT to guide treatment decisions.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the updated guidelines as a significant shift in clinical practice, recognizing that additional factors beyond traditional laboratory tests are necessary for making informed treatment decisions for HBV.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the need for a more nuanced approach to diagnosing and treating HBV, which can improve patient outcomes and guide future research and clinical protocols.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is based on a guideline update rather than original research, which may limit its strength. However, the guidelines are from reputable organizations, providing a moderate level of confidence in their recommendations.

analysis.summary_en: This study highlights the need to update treatment decisions for hepatitis B virus (HBV) based on more than just laboratory criteria. Traditionally, clinicians have relied on HBeAg, HBV DNA, and ALT levels to guide treatment, but the updated guidelines from the American Association for the Study of Liver Diseases and the Infectious Diseases Society of America suggest a broader approach. The study emphasizes that additional factors should be considered in making treatment decisions for HBV infection, which includes chronic and acute hepatitis B, HBV-related cirrhosis, and hepatocellular carcinoma. The findings suggest that the current practice of using only lab results may be insufficient, and a more comprehensive evaluation is necessary. The evidence is based on a guideline update, which provides a moderate level of confidence in the recommendations. These findings have important implications for improving clinical decision-making and patient outcomes in HBV management.

papers.title: Hepatitis B Vaccine as a Primary Prevention Strategy for Cancer: Mechanisms, Outcomes and Model Extension
papers.abstract: Vaccination against Hepatitis B can prevent liver cancer by preventing chronic infection of the liver. This paper reviews the role of hepatitis B virus (HBV) in hepatocellular carcinoma, cancer prevention via vaccination, and lessons learned from China's experience for other cancer-prevention programmes. HBV promotes cancer by inducing chronic inflammation in the host, integrating viral DNA into the host's DNA, and altering cell regulation through viral proteins. China's childhood vaccination programme has reduced infections among young children significantly. Extended data from the Qidong trial have also indicated a decrease in primary liver cancer; however, due to a small number of cancer cases, the exact extent remains unknown. Comparison with human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination shows that the biological principle can be applied to infections, but delivery needs to match the age and circumstances of the target population. China's addition of HPV vaccination to the national programme in 2025 is a policy change. Disease spread can be effectively prevented through timely vaccination, accessible medical services, and ongoing care for high-risk groups.

This paper reviews the role of hepatitis B virus (HBV) in hepatocellular carcinoma, cancer prevention via vaccination, and lessons learned from China's experience for other cancer-prevention programmes. HBV promotes cancer by inducing chronic inflammation in the host, integrating viral DNA into the host's DNA, and altering cell regulation through viral proteins. China's childhood vaccination programme has reduced infections among young children significantly. Extended data from the Qidong trial have also indicated a decrease in primary liver cancer; however, due to a small number of cancer cases, the exact extent remains unknown. Comparison with human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination shows that the biological principle can be applied to infections, but delivery needs to match the age and circumstances of the target population. China's addition of HPV vaccination to the national programme in 2025 is a policy change. Disease spread can be effectively prevented through timely vaccination, accessible medical services, and ongoing care for high-risk groups.

papers.title_original: Hepatitis B Vaccine as a Primary Prevention Strategy for Cancer: Mechanisms, Outcomes and Model Extension

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on the role of Hepatitis B virus (HBV) in hepatocellular carcinoma, the effectiveness of vaccination in preventing HBV infection and associated cancer, and the implications of China's childhood vaccination programme for cancer prevention strategies.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The paper is a review that examines the biological mechanisms of HBV in promoting cancer, the outcomes of vaccination programmes, and the lessons learned from China's experience. It does not explicitly report on the databases used, search dates, or eligibility criteria for included studies.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: HBV promotes cancer through chronic inflammation, integration of viral DNA into host DNA, and alteration of cell regulation via viral proteins. China's childhood vaccination programme has significantly reduced HBV infections among young children, and extended data from the Qidong trial suggest a decrease in primary liver cancer, although the exact extent remains uncertain due to the small number of cancer cases.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The exact extent of liver cancer reduction from the Qidong trial is not well established due to the limited number of cancer cases. There is also a need to consider the age and circumstances of the target population when applying biological principles from HBV vaccination to other infections, such as human papillomavirus (HPV).
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that expanding vaccination programmes to include HPV, as done in China in 2025, could be a policy change to enhance cancer prevention. It also highlights the importance of timely vaccination, accessible medical services, and ongoing care for high-risk groups to effectively prevent disease spread.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the role of Hepatitis B virus (HBV) in promoting hepatocellular carcinoma through mechanisms such as chronic inflammation, viral DNA integration, and altered cell regulation. It highlights the success of China's childhood HBV vaccination programme in reducing infections and suggests that extended data from the Qidong trial indicate a potential decrease in liver cancer, though the exact impact is unclear. The paper also compares HBV vaccination with HPV vaccination, emphasizing the need for tailored delivery strategies based on age and population-specific circumstances. It underscores the importance of integrating vaccination into broader public health strategies, including accessible medical services and care for high-risk groups, to effectively prevent HBV-related diseases. The review concludes that HBV vaccination remains a primary prevention strategy for liver cancer, with implications for future policy and research directions.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 综述聚焦于乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)在肝细胞癌中的作用,疫苗接种在预防HBV感染及其相关癌症中的有效性,以及中国儿童疫苗接种计划对癌症预防策略的启示。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本文是一篇综述,探讨了HBV促进癌症的生物学机制、疫苗接种计划的结果以及从中国经验中获得的启示。它并未明确报告所使用的数据库、检索日期或纳入研究的资格标准。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: HBV通过慢性炎症、将病毒DNA整合到肝脏DNA中以及通过病毒蛋白改变细胞调控来促进癌症发生。中国的儿童疫苗接种计划显著降低了年轻儿童的HBV感染率,而启东试验的扩展数据表明原发性肝癌有所减少,尽管由于癌症病例数量较少,确切的减少程度尚不确定。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 由于癌症病例数量有限,启东试验中肝癌减少的确切程度尚未明确。在将HBV疫苗接种的生物学原理应用于其他感染(如人乳头瘤病毒(HPV))时,还需要考虑目标人群的年龄和具体情况。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 综述建议将疫苗接种计划扩展至包括HPV,如中国于2025年所做的那样,这可能是一项增强癌症预防的政策变化。它还强调了及时的疫苗接种、可及的医疗服务以及对高危人群的持续照护对于有效防止疾病传播的重要性。

papers.abstract_zh: 通过预防肝脏慢性感染,针对乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)的疫苗接种可以预防肝癌。本文综述了HBV在肝细胞癌中的作用、疫苗接种在预防HBV感染及相关癌症中的效果,以及中国经验对其他癌症预防计划的启示。HBV通过诱导肝脏慢性炎症、将病毒DNA整合到肝脏DNA中以及通过病毒蛋白改变细胞调控来促进癌症发生。中国的儿童疫苗接种计划显著降低了年轻儿童的感染率。来自启东试验的扩展数据也表明原发性肝癌有所减少;然而,由于癌症病例数量较少,确切的减少程度尚不清楚。与人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)疫苗接种的比较显示,HBV疫苗接种的生物学原理可以应用于其他感染,但疫苗接种的实施需与目标人群的年龄和具体情况相匹配。中国于2025年将HPV疫苗接种纳入国家计划是一项政策变化。通过及时的疫苗接种、可及的医疗服务以及对高危人群的持续照护,可以有效防止疾病传播。

papers.title: Implementation outcomes of the framework for elimination of mother-to-child transmission of HIV, syphilis, hepatitis B and Chagas in a rural area from the Gran Chaco region: a retrospective cross-sectional study.
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVE: Describe and report the implementation of the framework for elimination of mother-to-child transmission (EMTCT) Plus, aimed at eliminating MTCT of HIV, syphilis, hepatitis B virus (HBV) and Chagas disease (ChD), in the rural binational Gran Chaco region between Argentina and Paraguay, including data on the prevalence, treatment and follow-up of mothers, their newborns (NBs) and their previous children. DESIGN: This initiative was implemented as a public-private partnership through continuous actions performed by local health personnel and periodic actions by a specialised health team, as part of antenatal care (ANC) through a retrospective cross-sectional study. SETTING: Implementation data from June 2018 up to December 2024 obtained through ANC performed in all the health posts, hospitals from the regions as well as through household visits. RESULTS: A total of 2664 pregnant women (mean age 24±7 years; 77.9% of indigenous origin) were enrolled, achieving >95% ANC coverage annually. Over the study period, the prevalence of Trypanosoma cruzi, causative agent of ChD, was 2.6% (68/2664; 95% CI 2.0 to 3.2), with annual rates decreasing from 4.7% (2019) to 1.7% (2024). cruzi-positive mothers, 14.7% (11/75) were diagnosed with congenital infection. In previously born children of seropositive mothers, the prevalence was 7.9%. Syphilis prevalence among pregnant women was 0.8% (21/2,664), with a rising trend from 0.5% (2018) to 1.4% (2024); no congenital syphilis cases were detected. No cases of HIV or hepatitis B were identified, consistent with the high vaccination coverage for HBV (>95%) and low prevalence in this region. Despite high detection and case management, only 58% of postpartum T. cruzi-positive women completed aetiological treatment, compared with 100% of positive NBs and 84.6% of previously born positive children. CONCLUSIONS: This comprehensive, patient-centred model succeeded in achieving diagnostic, coverage and treatment targets for neonates and children, but highlighted persistent challenges in postpartum maternal treatment adherence in the context of high population mobility and socio-environmental vulnerability.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to describe and report the implementation of the framework for elimination of mother-to-child transmission (EMTCT) Plus, focusing on the elimination of MTCT of HIV, syphilis, hepatitis B virus (HBV) and Chagas disease in a rural binational Gran Chaco region between Argentina and Paraguay.

Implementation data from June 2018 up to December 2024 obtained through ANC performed in all the health posts, hospitals from the regions as well as through household visits.
analysis.methods: Implementation data were collected through antenatal care (ANC) performed in all health posts, hospitals from the regions, and household visits. The study used a retrospective cross-sectional design to gather data on the prevalence, treatment, and follow-up of mothers, their newborns, and their previous children.
analysis.main_results: A total of 2664 pregnant women (mean age 24±7 years; 77.9% of indigenous origin) were enrolled, achieving >95% ANC coverage annually. analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study highlights the success of the framework in achieving diagnostic, coverage, and treatment targets for neonates and children, but also identifies persistent challenges in postpartum maternal treatment adherence due to high population mobility and socio-environmental vulnerability.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide insights into the effectiveness of the EMTCT Plus framework in reducing the transmission of HBV and other pathogens, which can inform future public health strategies and surveillance efforts in similar rural settings.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its retrospective design and potential for recall bias, but the evidence is strong due to the comprehensive data collection and high ANC coverage.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluates the implementation of the EMTCT Plus framework in the rural Gran Chaco region between Argentina and Paraguay, focusing on the elimination of mother-to-child transmission of HIV, syphilis, hepatitis B virus (HBV), and Chagas disease. The retrospective cross-sectional design collected data from June 2018 to December 2024 through antenatal care and household visits, enrolling 2664 pregnant women. The results show high ANC coverage (>95%) and a significant decrease in the prevalence of Trypanosoma cruzi from 4.7% in 2019 to 1.7% in 2024. Among previously born children of seropositive mothers, the prevalence was 7.9%. The study highlights the success of the framework in achieving diagnostic and treatment targets for neonates and children but also identifies challenges in maternal treatment adherence due to socio-environmental factors. The findings suggest that the EMTCT Plus model is effective in reducing transmission, offering valuable insights for public health strategies in similar regions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在描述并报告消除母婴传播框架(EMTCT Plus)的实施情况,重点关注在阿根廷和巴拉圭边境的农村格兰查科地区消除HIV、梅毒、乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)和恰加斯病的母婴传播。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该倡议通过公私合作模式实施,由当地卫生人员持续执行行动,由专门的卫生团队定期执行行动,作为产前检查(ANC)的一部分,采用回顾性横断面研究设计。从2018年6月至2024年12月,通过在所有卫生站、医院以及家庭访问中进行的产前检查,收集了实施数据。
elements_zh.methods: 通过在所有卫生站、医院以及家庭访问中进行的产前检查(ANC)收集实施数据。研究采用回顾性横断面设计,以收集母亲、其新生儿及其之前所生儿童的检测、治疗和随访数据。
elements_zh.main_results: 共纳入2664名孕妇(平均年龄24±7岁;77.9%为原住民),实现了每年超过95%的产前检查覆盖率。克氏锥虫(恰加斯病病原体)的检测率(患病率)为2.6%(68/2664;95% CI 2.0至3.2),年度检测率从2019年的4.7%下降到2024年的1.7%。在之前所生儿童中,克氏锥虫的检测率(患病率)为7.9%。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究突显了该框架在实现新生儿和儿童的诊断、覆盖率和治疗目标方面的成功,但也指出了在高人口流动和社会环境脆弱背景下,产后母亲治疗依从性持续存在的挑战。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果提供了关于EMTCT Plus框架在减少HBV和其他病原体母婴传播方面的有效性的见解,这可以为未来类似农村地区的公共卫生策略和治疗努力提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到回顾性设计和回忆偏倚的限制,但由于全面的数据收集和高产前检查覆盖率,其证据是强有力的。

analysis_en.main_results: A total of 2664 pregnant women (mean age 24±7 years; 77.9% of indigenous origin) were enrolled, achieving >95% ANC coverage annually. The prevalence of Trypanosoma cruzi, causative agent of Chagas disease, was 2.6% (68/2664; 95% CI 2.0 to 3.2), with annual rates decreasing from 4.7% (2019) to 1.7% (2024). Among previously born children of seropositive mothers, the prevalence was 7.9%.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The study highlights the success of the framework in achieving diagnostic, coverage, and treatment targets for neonates and children, but also identifies persistent challenges in postpartum maternal treatment adherence due to high population mobility and socio-environmental vulnerability.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide insights into the effectiveness of the EMTCT Plus framework in reducing the transmission of HBV and other pathogens, which can inform future public health strategies and surveillance efforts in similar rural settings.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its retrospective design and potential for recall bias, but the evidence is strong due to the comprehensive data collection and high ANC coverage.

papers.title_zh: 在阿根廷和巴拉圭边境的格兰查科农村地区实施消除母婴传播HIV、梅毒、乙型肝炎病毒和恰加斯病框架的成果:一项回顾性横断面研究。
papers.source_body_en: OBJECTIVE: Describe and report the implementation of the framework for elimination of mother-to-child transmission (EMTCT) Plus, aimed at eliminating MTCT of HIV, syphilis, hepatitis B virus (HBV) and Chagas disease (ChD), in the rural binational Gran Chaco region between Argentina and Paraguay, including data on the prevalence, treatment and follow-up of mothers, their newborns (NBs) and their previous children. DESIGN: This initiative was implemented as a public-private partnership through continuous actions performed by local health personnel and periodic actions by a specialised health team, as part of antenatal care (ANC) through a retrospective cross-sectional study. SETTING: Implementation data from June 2018 up to December 2024 obtained through ANC performed in all the health posts, hospitals from the regions as well as through household visits. RESULTS: A total of 2664 pregnant women (mean age 24±7 years; 77.9% of indigenous origin) were enrolled, achieving >95% ANC coverage annually. Over the study period, the prevalence of Trypanosoma cruzi, causative agent of ChD, was 2.6% (68/2664; 95% CI 2.0 to 3.2), with annual rates decreasing from 4.7% (2019) to 1.7% (2024). cruzi-positive mothers, 14.7% (11/75) were diagnosed with congenital infection. In previously born children of seropositive mothers, the prevalence was 7.9%. Syphilis prevalence among pregnant women was 0.8% (21/2,664), with a rising trend from 0.5% (2018) to 1.4% (2024); no congenital syphilis cases were detected. No cases of HIV or hepatitis B were identified, consistent with the high vaccination coverage for HBV (>95%) and low prevalence in this region. Despite high detection and case management, only 58% of postpartum T. cruzi-positive women completed aetiological treatment, compared with 100% of positive NBs and 84.6% of previously born positive children. CONCLUSIONS: This comprehensive, patient-centred model succeeded in achieving diagnostic, coverage and treatment targets for neonates and children, but highlighted persistent challenges in postpartum maternal treatment adherence in the context of high population mobility and socio-environmental vulnerability.
papers.abstract_zh: 目的:描述并报告消除母婴传播框架(EMTCT Plus)的实施情况,该框架旨在消除HIV、梅毒、乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)和恰加斯病(ChD)的母婴传播,在阿根廷和巴拉圭边境的农村格兰查科地区实施,包括对母亲、其新生儿(NBs)及其之前所生儿童的检测、治疗和随访数据。设计:该倡议通过公私合作模式实施,由当地卫生人员持续执行行动,由专门的卫生团队定期执行行动,作为产前检查(ANC)的一部分,采用回顾性横断面研究设计。背景:从2018年6月至2024年12月,通过在所有卫生站、医院以及家庭访问中进行的产前检查,收集了实施数据。结果:共纳入2664名孕妇(平均年龄24±7岁;77.9%为原住民),实现了每年超过95%的产前检查覆盖率。在研究期间,恰加斯病病原体克氏锥虫的检测率(患病率)为2.6%(68/2664;95% CI 2.0至3.2),年度检测率从2019年的4.7%下降到2024年的1.7%。在克氏锥虫阳性的母亲中,有14.7%(11/75)被诊断为先天性感染。在之前所生儿童中,克氏锥虫的检测率(患病率)为7.9%。孕妇中梅毒的检测率(患病率)为0.8%(21/2664),呈上升趋势,从2018年的0.5%上升到2024年的1.4%;未发现先天性梅毒病例。未发现HIV或乙型肝炎病毒的病例,这与该地区乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)的高检测覆盖率(>95%)以及低检测率一致。尽管检测和病例管理率较高,但只有58%的产后克氏锥虫阳性母亲完成了病因治疗(治疗),而新生儿和之前所生儿童的完成率分别为100%和84.6%。结论:这一全面、以患者为中心的模型成功实现了新生儿和儿童的诊断、覆盖率和治疗目标,但也突显了在高人口流动和社会环境脆弱背景下,产后母亲治疗依从性持续存在的挑战。科学与公共卫生意义:研究结果提供了关于EMTCT Plus框架在减少HBV和其他病原体母婴传播方面的有效性的见解,这可以为未来类似农村地区的公共卫生策略和治疗努力提供信息。局限性与证据强度:该研究受到回顾性设计和回忆偏倚的限制,但由于全面的数据收集和高产前检查覆盖率,其证据是强有力的。

papers.title: Don't Drop the B: Risk of Hepatitis B Virus Infection and Reactivation in the Era of Tenofovir-Sparing Regimens for Treatment and Prevention of HIV.
papers.abstract: Tenofovir-sparing antiretroviral therapy (ART) and pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) for human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) are increasingly used. However, these regimens may increase the risk of new hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection or reactivation due to lack of full activity against HBV. The magnitude and mechanism of risk can vary by baseline HBV serologic profile and need to be discussed with the patient before switching regimens. Importantly, these risks can be mitigated through HBV screening, vaccination, and post-switch monitoring. Here, we synthesize the evidence across different clinical scenarios and propose a practical workflow to reduce the potential but preventable risk during transitions to tenofovir-sparing regimens. Finally, we highlight knowledge gaps and outline future research priorities. The decision to switch to tenofovir-sparing ART or PrEP should not be made solely through the lens of HIV efficacy and convenience and must incorporate HBV prevention and reactivation risk.
papers.journal: Clinical infectious diseases : an official publication of the Infectious Diseases Society of America

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on the risk of hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection and reactivation in the context of tenofovir-sparing regimens for HIV treatment and prevention. It addresses the impact of these regimens on HBV, particularly in relation to baseline HBV serologic profiles and the need for patient-specific discussions before regimen changes.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review synthesizes evidence from various clinical scenarios, emphasizing the importance of HBV screening, vaccination, and post-switch monitoring to mitigate risks. It does not explicitly report on databases, search dates, or eligibility criteria, but it outlines a practical workflow for managing HBV risks during transitions to tenofovir-sparing regimens.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that the risk of HBV infection or reactivation can be reduced through HBV screening, vaccination, and post-switch monitoring. It highlights the variability of risk based on baseline HBV serologic profiles and the necessity of incorporating HBV prevention strategies into decision-making for tenofovir-sparing regimens.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review identifies knowledge gaps and outlines future research priorities, particularly in understanding the mechanisms of HBV risk and the effectiveness of mitigation strategies. It also notes that the decision to switch to tenofovir-sparing regimens should not be based solely on HIV efficacy and convenience but must consider HBV prevention and reactivation risks.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review emphasizes the need for HBV screening, vaccination, and post-switch monitoring as critical steps in reducing the risk of HBV infection or reactivation. It also suggests that future research should focus on clarifying the mechanisms of HBV risk and improving strategies for HBV prevention in the context of tenofovir-sparing regimens.

analysis.summary_en: This review examines the risk of hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection and reactivation associated with tenofovir-sparing antiretroviral therapy (ART) and pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) for HIV. It highlights that the risk varies depending on baseline HBV serologic profiles and underscores the importance of HBV screening, vaccination, and post-switch monitoring to mitigate these risks. The review proposes a practical workflow for managing HBV risks during transitions to tenofovir-sparing regimens and identifies knowledge gaps that require further research. It stresses that decisions regarding regimen changes should consider HBV prevention and reactivation risks alongside HIV efficacy and convenience.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述聚焦于在无替诺福韦方案治疗HIV和预防中乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)感染及再激活的风险。它探讨了这些方案对HBV的影响,特别是与基线HBV血清学特征的关系,以及在方案变更前进行患者特定讨论的必要性。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述综合了不同临床情境的证据,强调了通过HBV筛查、疫苗接种和换方案后的监测来缓解风险的重要性。它并未明确报告数据库、检索日期或纳入标准,但提出了一个实用的工作流程,用于管理在转向无替诺福韦方案过程中HBV的风险。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 综述得出结论,通过HBV筛查、疫苗接种和换方案后的监测可以降低HBV感染或再激活的风险。它强调了风险的变异性取决于基线HBV血清学特征,并指出在无替诺福韦方案决策中必须纳入HBV预防策略。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 综述指出了知识空白并概述了未来研究的重点,特别是在理解HBV风险的机制和缓解策略的有效性方面。它还指出,转向无替诺福韦方案的决策不应仅基于HIV疗效和便利性,还必须考虑HBV预防和再激活风险。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 综述强调了HBV筛查、疫苗接种和换方案后的监测作为减少HBV感染或再激活风险的关键步骤。它还建议未来研究应着重于阐明HBV风险的机制,并改善在无替诺福韦方案背景下的HBV预防策略。

papers.abstract_zh: 无替诺福韦抗逆转录病毒治疗(ART)和用于人类免疫缺陷病毒(HIV)的暴露前预防(PrEP)正日益被使用。然而,这些方案可能因对乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)缺乏完全活性而增加新HBV感染或再激活的风险。风险的大小和机制可能因基线HBV血清学特征而异,因此在更换方案前需要与患者进行讨论。重要的是,这些风险可以通过HBV筛查、疫苗接种和换方案后的监测来缓解。本文综合不同临床情境的证据,提出一个实用的工作流程,以减少在转向无替诺福韦方案过程中潜在但可预防的HBV风险。最后,我们强调知识空白并概述未来研究的重点。在决定转向无替诺福韦方案的ART或PrEP时,不应仅从HIV疗效和便利性的角度出发,还必须纳入HBV预防和再激活风险的考量。

papers.title: Anti-Viral Treatment Eligibility and Treatment Uptake Among People With Chronic Hepatitis B in Australia: The REACH-B Study.
papers.abstract: Treatment indication for chronic hepatitis B (CHB) varies across clinical guidelines. This study evaluated treatment eligibility and uptake in a large Australian cohort of people with CHB. The REACH-B study recruited people with CHB managed through a national network of healthcare services. Participants were categorised into three groups: (1) receiving antiviral therapy; (2) untreated despite eligibility; (3) untreated and ineligible. Treatment eligibility was determined using Australian Pharmaceutical Benefits Scheme (PBS) criteria, and by international clinical guidelines. Among 3648 participants (56% male; median age 48 years; 49% born in North-East or South-East Asia; 27% First Nations Australians), 14% were HBeAg positive and 7% had cirrhosis. Overall, 47% (n = 1666) were on antiviral therapy, 45% (n = 1573) were untreated and ineligible and 7% (n = 251) were untreated despite eligibility based on Australian PBS criteria. In adjusted analysis, the likelihood of remaining untreated despite eligibility was higher among women (aOR 1.59, 95% CI 1.34, 1.88) and younger participants (age 41-60 vs. > 60 years: aOR 1.51, 95% CI 1.01-2.28; ≤ 40 vs. > 60 years: aOR 2.65, 95% CI 1.60, 4.40). The proportion untreated despite eligibility increased to 13% when applying 2024 World Health Organisation guidelines and ranged 2%-44% based on other guidelines, highlighting the variability across the guidelines. In conclusion, among REACH-B participants, most eligible individuals receive treatment. Lower treatment uptake among women and younger people despite eligibility partly reflects lower threshold for elevated ALT in women, and clinician determination of non-CHB related ALT elevation. As treatment guidelines evolve and eligibility criteria broaden, monitoring treatment patterns is important.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 治疗 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 的适应症因临床指南而异。本研究旨在评估大量澳大利亚 队列研究 慢性乙型肝炎患者的 治疗 资格和使用情况。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: REACH-B 研究招募了通过全国医疗服务网络管理的慢性乙型肝炎患者。参与者被分为三组:(1)接受抗病毒药物治疗;(2) 尽管符合资格但未接受治疗;(3)未经治疗且不符合资格的。在 3648 名参与者中(56% 为男性;中位年龄 48 岁;49% 出生于东北亚或东南亚;27% 为澳大利亚原住民),14% 的人 HBeAg 呈阳性,7% 的人患有肝硬化。
elements_zh.methods: 治疗 资格是根据澳大利亚药品福利计划 (PBS) 标准和国际临床指南确定的。
elements_zh.main_results: 总体而言,47% (n = 1666) 接受 抗病毒药物 治疗,45% (n = 1573) 未接受治疗且不符合资格,7% (n = 251) 尽管根据澳大利亚 PBS 标准符合资格但未接受治疗。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: In adjusted analysis, the likelihood of remaining untreated despite eligibility was higher among women (aOR 1.59, 95% CI 1.34, 1.88) and younger participants (age 41-60 vs. > 60 years: aOR 1.51, 95% CI 1.01-2.28; ≤ 40 vs. 41-60 years: aOR 1.85, 95% CI 1.34-2.56). The proportion untreated despite eligibility increased to 13% when applying 2024 World Health Organisation guidelines and ranged 2%-44% based on other guidelines, highlighting the variability across the guidelines.
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调了各指南中 治疗 资格标准的可变性,并强调了随着指南的发展监测 治疗 模式的重要性。尽管符合资格,但女性和年轻人的 治疗 摄取率较低,部分反映了女性 ALT 升高的阈值较低,以及临床医生对非 CHB 相关 ALT 升高的判断。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性在于其依赖于自我报告的数据以及临床医生确定非 CHB 相关 ALT 升高的潜在偏差。证据是中等的,因为它基于观察数据,不包括实验或纵向随访。

In conclusion, among REACH-B participants, most eligible individuals receive treatment. Lower treatment uptake among women and younger people despite eligibility partly reflects lower threshold for elevated ALT in women, and clinician determination of non-CHB related ALT elevation. As treatment guidelines evolve and eligibility criteria broaden, monitoring treatment patterns is important.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 治疗 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 的适应症因临床指南而异。本研究旨在评估大量澳大利亚 队列研究 慢性乙型肝炎患者的 治疗 资格和使用情况。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: REACH-B 研究招募了通过全国医疗服务网络管理的慢性乙型肝炎患者。参与者被分为三组:(1)接受抗病毒药物治疗;(2) 尽管符合资格但未接受治疗;(3)未经治疗且不符合资格的。在 3648 名参与者中(56% 为男性;中位年龄 48 岁;49% 出生于东北亚或东南亚;27% 为澳大利亚原住民),14% 的人 HBeAg 呈阳性,7% 的人患有肝硬化。
analysis_zh.methods: 治疗 资格是根据澳大利亚药品福利计划 (PBS) 标准和国际临床指南确定的。
analysis_zh.main_results: 总体而言,47% (n = 1666) 接受 抗病毒药物 治疗,45% (n = 1573) 未接受治疗且不符合资格,7% (n = 251) 尽管根据澳大利亚 PBS 标准符合资格但未接受治疗。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调了各指南中 治疗 资格标准的可变性,并强调了随着指南的发展监测 治疗 模式的重要性。尽管符合资格,但女性和年轻人的 治疗 摄取率较低,部分反映了女性 ALT 升高的阈值较低,以及临床医生对非 CHB 相关 ALT 升高的判断。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性在于其依赖于自我报告的数据以及临床医生确定非 CHB 相关 ALT 升高的潜在偏差。证据是中等的,因为它基于观察数据,不包括实验或纵向随访。

papers.title: Incidence and Factors Associated With Incident Hepatitis B Virus Infection in African Populations: A Systematic Review
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains an important public health concern in Africa, where ongoing transmission contributes to the burden of chronic liver disease and related complications. Although HBV prevalence in African populations has been widely studied, evidence regarding incident HBV infection and factors associated with newly acquired infection is less consistently characterized. This systematic review aimed to synthesize the available evidence on the incidence of incident HBV infection and associated factors among populations in Africa. Methods A systematic literature search was conducted in PubMed using the search strategy: "("hepatitis B" OR HBV) AND (incident OR incidence OR seroconversion OR "new infection") AND (Africa OR African)". Studies were eligible if they were conducted in African populations and reported incident HBV infection, HBV seroconversion, or incidence based on longitudinal or repeated testing among adults. Studies were screened according to predefined eligibility criteria, and relevant data were extracted from eligible full-text studies. Risk of bias was assessed using the Newcastle–Ottawa Scale (NOS) for cohort studies.. Due to substantial heterogeneity In study populations, settings, study designs, follow-up periods, and outcome definitions, findings were synthesized narratively rather than through meta-analysis. Results Five studies conducted in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Côte d’Ivoire, Burkina Faso, Botswana, and Malawi met the inclusion criteria. The studies included predominantly blood donors, while one study evaluated HIV-infected treatment-naïve adults. Reported HBV incidence varied considerably across settings. Incidence was 25.4 per 1000 person-years in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, 3.6 per 100 person-years in Botswana, and 13.7 per 1000 person-years in Malawi. In Côte d’Ivoire, HBV seroconversion incidence decreased from 7.3 per 100 person-years in 1992–1994 to 0.2 per 100 person-years in 2010–2012. The Burkina Faso study also reported incident HBV infection among repeat blood donors. Factors associated with incident infection varied between studies, with differences observed according to donor type, age, geographical setting, and population characteristics. However, findings were not sufficiently consistent to identify a single set of risk factors across African populations. Conclusion Incident HBV infection continues to occur among adults in several African settings, although incidence varies substantially across populations and study periods. The available evidence is limited and heterogeneous, with a predominance of blood-donor populations and relatively limited representation of the general adult population. Further longitudinal studies using standardized definitions and broader population-based samples are needed to better characterize the incidence and determinants of newly acquired HBV infection in Africa.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 发病率(HBV)感染仍然是非洲的重要公共卫生问题,持续的传播导致慢性肝病及相关并发症的负担。尽管HBV在非洲人群中的患病率已被广泛研究,但关于新发HBV感染及其相关因素的证据则较为不一致。本系统综述旨在综合非洲人群中新发HBV感染的发病率及其相关因素的现有证据。方法 通过PubMed进行系统文献检索,使用以下检索策略:("hepatitis B" OR HBV) AND (incident OR 发病率 OR seroconversion OR "new infection") AND (Africa OR African)。纳入标准为:研究对象为非洲人群,且报告了基于纵向或重复检测的新发HBV感染、HBV血清转换或发病率。研究根据预定义的纳入标准进行筛选,并从符合标准的全文研究中提取相关数据。使用Newcastle–Ottawa量表(NOS)评估队列研究研究中的偏倚风险。由于研究人群、环境、研究设计、随访时间和结局定义存在显著异质性,因此采用叙述性综合而非元分析来汇总结果。结果 有五项研究符合纳入标准,分别来自刚果民主共和国、科特迪瓦、布基纳法索、博茨瓦纳和马拉维。这些研究主要针对献血者,其中一项研究评估了未接受治疗的HIV感染者。报告的HBV 发病率在不同环境中差异较大。刚果民主共和国的发病率为每1000人年25.4,博茨瓦纳为每100人年3.6,马拉维为每1000人年13.7。在科特迪瓦,HBV血清转换的发病率从1992–1994年的每100人年7.3下降到2010–2012年的每100人年0.2。布基纳法索的研究也报告了重复献血者中新发HBV感染的情况。与新发感染相关的因素在不同研究中存在差异,这些差异根据献血类型、年龄、地理环境和人群特征而有所不同。然而,结果并不足够一致,无法确定非洲人群中统一的风险因素集。结论 新发HBV感染在非洲的多个环境中仍持续发生,尽管发病率在不同人群和研究期间存在显著差异。现有证据有限且异质性较大,主要来自献血者人群,而一般成人人群的代表性相对不足。需要进一步进行纵向研究,采用标准化定义和更广泛的人群样本,以更好地描述非洲地区新发HBV感染的发病率及其决定因素。

papers.title: Long-Term Five-Year Effectiveness of Tenofovir Alafenamide in Japanese Patients With Chronic Hepatitis B: A Prospective Multicenter Registry Study.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND/AIMS: Tenofovir alafenamide (TAF) is recommended as a first-line therapy for chronic hepatitis B (CHB); however, long-term real-world data in Japan are limited. This study aimed to evaluate the 5-year efficacy of TAF in a multicenter cohort. METHODS: This prospective multicenter registry study included 638 patients with CHB who initiated TAF therapy between March 2019 and March 2025. The primary outcomes were the HBV-DNA suppression rate and alanine aminotransferase (ALT) normalization rate at 5 years. Subgroup analyses were performed according to treatment history, disease stage, and renal function. RESULTS: The HBV-DNA suppression rate increased over time and reached 97% at 5 years. Comparable suppression rates were observed between treatment-naïve patients and patients switched from other nucleos(t)ide analogues (NAs) to TAF (97% vs. 97%, p = 1.0), as well as between patients with chronic hepatitis and those with liver cirrhosis (97% vs. The overall ALT normalization rate at 5 years was 84%. Among patients switched from other NAs to TAF with detectable HBV-DNA at baseline, 87% achieved viral suppression. In patients with renal impairment (eGFR < 60 mL/min/1.73 m2), the suppression rate was 97%, comparable to those with normal renal function (97%, p = 1.0). CONCLUSION: TAF demonstrated sustained and high antiviral efficacy over 5 years in a real-world Japanese cohort, including in patients switched from other nucleos(t)ide analogues and those with renal impairment. These findings support the long-term effectiveness of TAF across a broad spectrum of patients with CHB in routine clinical practice.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景/目的:tenofovir alafenamide(TAF)被推荐为慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)的一线治疗药物;然而,日本的长期真实世界数据有限。本研究旨在评估TAF在多中心慢性乙型肝炎注册研究中的5年疗效。方法:这项前瞻性多中心注册研究纳入了638名在2019年3月至2025年3月期间开始TAF治疗的慢性乙型肝炎患者。主要结局指标为5年时的HBV-DNA抑制率和丙氨酸氨基转移酶(ALT)正常化率。根据慢性乙型肝炎病史、疾病阶段和肾功能进行了亚组分析。结果:HBV-DNA抑制率随时间增加,并在5年时达到97%。在从未接受过治疗的患者和从其他核苷(类核苷)类似物(NAs)转换为TAF的患者中,抑制率相当(97% vs. 97%,p = 1.0),同样在慢性肝炎患者和肝硬化患者中抑制率相当(97% vs. 97%,p = 1.0)。5年时总体ALT正常化率为84%。在基线时HBV-DNA可检测的患者中,从其他NAs转换为TAF的患者中有87%实现了病毒抑制。在肾功能不全(eGFR < 60 mL/min/1.73 m2)的患者中,抑制率为97%,与肾功能正常的患者相当(97%,p = 1.0)。结论:TAF在真实世界日本慢性乙型肝炎患者中表现出持续且高度的疗效,持续5年,包括从其他核苷(类核苷)类似物转换的患者和肾功能不全的患者。这些发现支持TAF在慢性乙型肝炎常规临床实践中的长期有效性。

papers.title: Laboratory Models of Hepatitis B and D Viruses: Search for Cell Permissiveness and Restriction Factors
papers.abstract: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) is an oncogenic human pathogen that accounts for 250 mln cases of chronic hepatitis worldwide. Hepatitis delta virus (HDV) is its satellite that substantially aggravates liver disease. The development of new antivirals and the investigation of viral pathogenesis are limited by the absence of effective cellular and animal models. Current cell models are based on human primary hepatocytes, liver progenitor HepaRG cells, iPS-derived hepatocyte-like cells or various hepatoma cells overexpressing the putative NTCP receptor. However, in most of these models, a majority of cells are non-permissive. In this review, we briefly assess these models, summarize the approaches to the increasing infection rates, and discuss the data on proviral and antiviral (restriction) host factors. The data discussed suggest that rates of HBV and HDV infections are limited by hepatocyte polarization and insufficient expression of the NTCP receptor, as well as the existence of additional co-receptors and restriction factors that can act mostly on the virus entry stage.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on human hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection, its genotypes, and associated diseases. The central question is to evaluate laboratory models for HBV and its satellite hepatitis delta virus (HDV), particularly regarding cell permissiveness and restriction factors.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a systematic assessment of laboratory models for HBV and HDV. It discusses the use of human primary hepatocytes, liver progenitor HepaRG cells, iPS-derived hepatocyte-like cells, and hepatoma cells overexpressing the NTCP receptor. The review does not explicitly report on meta-analysis or pooled estimates but summarizes existing approaches and data on host factors.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that the development of new antivirals and understanding of viral pathogenesis are limited by the lack of effective cellular and animal models. It highlights that current models have a majority of non-permissive cells and that infection rates are constrained by hepatocyte polarization, insufficient NTCP receptor expression, and the presence of additional co-receptors and restriction factors primarily acting during the virus entry stage.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: There is a lack of consensus on the exact mechanisms limiting HBV and HDV infection rates. The evidence suggests that hepatocyte polarization and NTCP receptor expression levels are key factors, but the existence of additional co-receptors and restriction factors remains unresolved. The review also notes that the absence of effective models hinders research progress.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review implies the need for improved cellular and animal models to better understand HBV and HDV infection mechanisms and to develop effective antivirals. It also suggests the importance of investigating hepatocyte polarization, NTCP receptor expression, and other restriction factors to enhance research and therapeutic strategies.

analysis.summary_en: This review evaluates laboratory models for hepatitis B virus (HBV) and its satellite hepatitis delta virus (HDV), focusing on cell permissiveness and restriction factors. It highlights the limitations of current models, which are based on human primary hepatocytes, HepaRG cells, iPS-derived hepatocyte-like cells, and hepatoma cells overexpressing the NTCP receptor. The review identifies that most of these models are non-permissive, and infection rates are constrained by hepatocyte polarization, insufficient NTCP receptor expression, and additional co-receptors and restriction factors. The findings emphasize the need for improved models to advance research on HBV and HDV pathogenesis and antiviral development.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述聚焦于人类乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)感染、其基因型及相关疾病。核心问题是评估HBV及其卫星病毒丁型肝炎病毒(HDV)的实验室模型,特别是关于细胞允许性和限制因子。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述是对HBV和HDV实验室模型的系统评估。它讨论了使用人类原代肝细胞、肝祖细胞HepaRG、诱导多能干细胞(iPS)衍生的肝细胞样细胞以及过表达NTCP受体的肝癌细胞。综述未明确报告元分析或汇总估计,但总结了现有方法和关于限制因子的数据。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 综述得出结论,新的治疗手段和对病毒限制因子的理解受到有效细胞和动物模型缺乏的限制。它指出当前模型中大多数细胞不具有允许性,并且感染率受到肝细胞极化、NTCP受体表达不足以及存在其他共受体和限制因子的限制,这些因子主要在病毒进入阶段起作用。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 关于限制HBV和HDV感染率的确切机制尚无共识。证据表明肝细胞极化和NTCP受体表达水平是关键因素,但其他共受体和限制因子的存在仍未解决。综述还指出,缺乏有效的模型阻碍了研究进展。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 综述暗示需要改进细胞和动物模型,以更好地理解HBV和HDV的感染机制,并开发有效的治疗手段。它还建议应研究肝细胞极化、NTCP受体表达及其他限制因子,以增强研究和治疗策略。

analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述是对HBV和HDV实验室模型的系统评估。它讨论了使用人类原代肝细胞、肝祖细胞HepaRG、诱导多能干细胞(iPS)衍生的肝细胞样细胞以及过表达NTCP受体的肝癌细胞。综述未明确报告元分析或汇总估计,但总结了现有方法和关于限制因子的数据。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 综述得出结论,新的治疗手段和对病毒限制因子的理解受到有效细胞和动物模型缺乏的限制。它指出当前模型中大多数细胞不具有允许性,并且感染率受到肝细胞极化、NTCP受体表达不足以及存在其他共受体和限制因子的限制,这些因子主要在病毒进入阶段起作用。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 关于限制HBV和HDV感染率的确切机制尚无共识。证据表明肝细胞极化和NTCP受体表达水平是关键因素,但其他共受体和限制因子的存在仍未解决。综述还指出,缺乏有效的模型阻碍了研究进展。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 综述暗示需要改进细胞和动物模型,以更好地理解HBV和HDV的感染机制,并开发有效的治疗手段。它还建议应研究肝细胞极化、NTCP受体表达及其他限制因子,以增强研究和治疗策略。

papers.title: Longitudinal liver stiffness trajectories and dynamic prediction of liver-related events in chronic hepatitis B.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE: Serial liver stiffness measurement (LSM) captures evolving disease severity in chronic hepatitis B (CHB), but its longitudinal phenotypes and prognostic value remain uncertain. We aimed to characterize LSM trajectories and develop and externally validate joint models for individualized dynamic prediction of liver-related events (LREs). METHODS: We analyzed a Beijing development cohort (n=3,927), two external-validation cohorts (n=1,987 and n=747), and a histology-characterized dataset (n=579). Latent class mixed models characterized LSM trajectories, and Bayesian joint models linked repeated LSM measurements with time-to-event outcomes to generate individualized risk estimates. RESULTS: Six LSM phenotypes showed marked prognostic separation, with 9-year LRE incidence ranging from 1.3 to 63.1% (p < 0.001). Despite rapid LSM decline, the moderate-baseline rapid-decline phenotype retained excess hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) risk versus the persistent low-stable phenotype (adjusted HR 3.46, 95% CI 1.67-7.18). Each 20% increase in updated LSM was associated with LREs (adjusted HR 1.37, 95% CI 1.29-1.46), hepatic decompensation (1.55, 1.43-1.68), and HCC (1.23, 1.14-1.33). For 3-year LRE prediction, the dynamic LSM joint model achieved a mean landmark AUC of 0.833 and generally outperformed joint models based on serial PLT, APRI, and FIB-4, as well as Cox models using the most recent or baseline LSM (median ΔAUC 0.050 [IQR 0.030-0.079] and 0.100 [0.094-0.114], respectively). Adding clinical covariates increased the mean AUC to 0.859, and the final model showed good discrimination in SYSU3 and GEH-SMU (AUCs 0.854 and 0.827, respectively). CONCLUSIONS: Serial LSM captures clinically meaningful longitudinal heterogeneity in CHB and supports individualized, dynamically updated risk prediction.

analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The study characterized longitudinal LSM phenotypes and developed a dynamic prediction model for liver-related events in CHB, showing that rapid LSM decline retained excess HCC risk and that updated LSM improved prediction accuracy.

papers.title_zh: 慢性乙型肝炎患者纵向肝硬度轨迹及肝相关事件的动态预测
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE: Serial liver stiffness measurement (LSM) captures evolving disease severity in chronic hepatitis B (CHB), but its longitudinal phenotypes and prognostic value remain uncertain. We aimed to characterize LSM trajectories and develop and externally validate joint models for individualized dynamic prediction of liver-related events (LREs). METHODS: We analyzed a Beijing development cohort (n=3,927), two external-validation cohorts (n=1,987 and n=747), and a histology-characterized dataset (n=579). Latent class mixed models characterized LSM trajectories, and Bayesian joint models linked repeated LSM measurements with time-to-event outcomes to generate individualized risk estimates. RESULTS: Six LSM phenotypes showed marked prognostic separation, with 9-year LRE incidence ranging from 1.3 to 63.1% (p < 0.001). Despite rapid LSM decline, the moderate-baseline rapid-decline phenotype retained excess hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) risk versus the persistent low-stable phenotype (adjusted HR 3.46, 95% CI 1.67-7.18). Each 20% increase in updated LSM was associated with LREs (adjusted HR 1.37, 95% CI 1.29-1.46), hepatic decompensation (1.55, 1.43-1.68), and HCC (1.23, 1.14-1.33). For 3-year LRE prediction, the dynamic LSM joint model achieved a mean landmark AUC of 0.833 and generally outperformed joint models based on serial PLT, APRI, and FIB-4, as well as Cox models using the most recent or baseline LSM (median ΔAUC 0.050 [IQR 0.030-0.079] and 0.100 [0.094-0.114], respectively). Adding clinical covariates increased the mean AUC to 0.859, and the final model showed good discrimination in SYSU3 and GEH-SMU (AUCs 0.854 and 0.827, respectively). CONCLUSIONS: Serial LSM captures clinically meaningful longitudinal heterogeneity in CHB and supports individualized, dynamically updated risk prediction.

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究分析了北京开发队列队列研究(n=3,927)、两个外部验证队列队列研究(n=1,987和n=747),以及一个组织学特征数据集(n=579)。

papers.title: Serological Evidence of Hepatitis B Virus Vaccination Among University Students in Lafia, Nigeria
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Hepatitis B virus (HBV) vaccination is highly effective, yet protection is not guaranteed to be lifelong, and evidence on how long vaccine-induced immunity persists among Nigerian university students remains limited. This study assessed serological evidence of protection against HBV among vaccinated students of the Federal University of Lafia (FULAFIA) and examined the factors associated with its persistence. Methods A descriptive cross-sectional study was conducted among 120 students with a documented or self-reported history of HBV vaccination. Structured questionnaires captured demographic, vaccination, and lifestyle data, and venous blood samples were screened using an HBV rapid diagnostic test (RDT) combo panel (HBsAg, anti-HBs, HBeAg, HBeAb, HBcAb). Associations between anti-HBs status and selected variables were tested using chi-square and Fisher's exact tests (α = 0.05). Results Detectable anti-HBs was found in 51.7% (62/120) of participants; 48.3% (58/120) showed no serological evidence of protection. One participant (0.8%) was HBsAg-positive with a marker profile consistent with chronic HBeAg-negative phase infection. Time since last vaccination was the strongest correlate of protection (χ2 = 56.92, df = 4, p < 0.001), with protection falling from 87.9% in those vaccinated under 5 years ago to 0.0% beyond 15 years. Age at vaccination was also significant (χ2 = 39.19, df = 3, p < 0.001), whereas current age group (p = 0.272), sex (p = 0.417), and number of doses received (p = 0.052) were not. Conclusions Nearly half of vaccinated students at this Nigerian university no longer show serological evidence of protection against HBV, driven principally by time elapsed since vaccination rather than by demographic characteristics. These findings support the introduction of post-vaccination serological screening and targeted booster vaccination in university health services, and add university-level evidence to the ongoing debate over WHO's no-routine-booster guidance in high-endemicity settings. Trial registration: Not applicable.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the persistence of HBV vaccine-induced immunity among Nigerian university students. The strongest factor associated with protection was the time since vaccination, with immunity decreasing significantly over time. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)疫苗接种效果显著,但无法保证终身保护,目前关于尼日利亚大学学生中HBV疫苗接种后免疫持续时间的证据仍有限。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究评估了接种疫苗学生对HBV的血清学保护证据,并探讨了其持续的相关因素,研究对象为拉菲亚联邦大学(FULAFIA)的学生。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究对120名有疫苗接种记录或自述接种过HBV疫苗的学生进行了描述性横断面研究。通过结构化问卷收集了人口学、疫苗接种和生活方式数据,并使用HBV快速诊断测试(RDT)组合面板(HBsAg、anti-HBs、HBeAg、HBeAb、HBcAb)检测静脉血样。采用卡方检验和Fisher精确检验(α = 0.05)分析anti-HBs状态与选定变量之间的关联。
elements_zh.main_results: 51.7%(62/120)的参与者检测到可检测的anti-HBs;48.3%(58/120)未显示血清学保护证据。一名参与者(0.8%)HBsAg阳性,其标记谱与慢性HBeAg阴性期感染一致。

papers.title_zh: 拉菲亚大学学生中乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)疫苗接种后血清学证据的研究
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background Hepatitis B virus (HBV) vaccination is highly effective, yet protection is not guaranteed to be lifelong, and evidence on how long vaccine-induced immunity persists among Nigerian university students remains limited. This study assessed serological evidence of protection against HBV among vaccinated students of the Federal University of Lafia (FULAFIA) and examined the factors associated with its persistence. Methods A descriptive cross-sectional study was conducted among 120 students with a documented or self-reported history of HBV vaccination. Structured questionnaires captured demographic, vaccination, and lifestyle data, and venous blood samples were screened using an HBV rapid diagnostic test (RDT) combo panel (HBsAg, anti-HBs, HBeAg, HBeAb, HBcAb). Associations between anti-HBs status and selected variables were tested using chi-square and Fisher's exact tests (α = 0.05). Results Detectable anti-HBs was found in 51.7% (62/120) of participants; 48.3% (58/120) showed no serological evidence of protection. One participant (0.8%) was HBsAg-positive with a marker profile consistent with chronic HBeAg-negative phase infection. Time since last vaccination was the strongest correlate of protection (χ2 = 56.92, df = 4, p < 0.001), with protection falling from 87.9% in those vaccinated under 5 years ago to 0.0% beyond 15 years. Age at vaccination was also significant (χ2 = 39.19, df = 3, p < 0.001), whereas current age group (p = 0.272), sex (p = 0.417), and number of doses received (p = 0.052) were not. Conclusions Nearly half of vaccinated students at this Nigerian university no longer show serological evidence of protection against HBV, driven principally by time elapsed since vaccination rather than by demographic characteristics. These findings support the introduction of post-vaccination serological screening and targeted booster vaccination in university health services, and add university-level evidence to the ongoing debate over WHO's no-routine-booster guidance in high-endemicity settings. Trial registration: Not applicable.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)疫苗接种效果显著,但无法保证终身保护,目前关于尼日利亚大学学生中HBV疫苗接种后免疫持续时间的证据仍有限。本研究评估了拉菲亚联邦大学(FULAFIA)接种疫苗学生的HBV血清学保护证据,并探讨了其持续的相关因素。方法 本研究对120名有疫苗接种记录或自述接种过HBV疫苗的学生进行了描述性横断面研究。通过结构化问卷收集了人口学、疫苗接种和生活方式数据,并使用HBV快速诊断测试(RDT)组合面板(HBsAg、anti-HBs、HBeAg、HBeAb、HBcAb)检测静脉血样。采用卡方检验和Fisher精确检验(α = 0.05)分析anti-HBs状态与选定变量之间的关联。结果 51.7%(62/120)的参与者检测到可检测的anti-HBs;48.3%(58/120)未显示血清学保护证据。一名参与者(0.8%)HBsAg阳性,其标记谱与慢性HBeAg阴性期感染一致。疫苗接种后的时间是保护的最强相关因素(χ2 = 56.92,df = 4,p < 0.001),在接种后5年内的参与者保护率为87.9%,而在接种后15年以上的参与者保护率为0.0%。接种时的年龄也具有显著性(χ2 = 39.19,df = 3,p < 0.001),而当前年龄组(p = 0.272)、性别(p = 0.417)和接种剂量数量(p = 0.052)则不显著。结论 这所尼日利亚大学中近一半的接种疫苗学生不再显示对HBV的血清学保护证据,这主要由疫苗接种后的时间间隔决定,而非人口学特征。这些发现支持在大学健康服务中引入疫苗接种后血清学筛查和针对性加强接种,并为世界卫生组织在高流行地区不推荐常规加强接种的指导方针提供了大学层面的证据。试验注册:不适用。

papers.title: Determinants and Barriers to Hepatitis B Vaccination Uptake Among Undergraduate Students at Al Hikmah University Ilorin Nigeria
papers.abstract: Abstract Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains an important preventable cause of chronic liver disease, cirrhosis and liver cancer. University students may remain susceptible when childhood vaccination was missed or incomplete, yet institution-specific evidence on vaccination behavior is limited. This study assessed hepatitis B vaccination uptake and identified associated determinants and perceived barriers among undergraduate students at Al-Hikmah University, Ilorin, Nigeria. An analytical cross-sectional study was conducted among consenting undergraduates during the 2025/2026 academic session. A structured electronic questionnaire assessed sociodemographic characteristics, HBV knowledge, vaccination history, attitudes, Health Belief Model constructs, information sources and barriers. Data were analyzed using descriptive statistics, chi-square tests, independent-samples t-tests and binary logistic regression. Of 361 students who accessed the questionnaire, 351 consented and were analyzed. Awareness of HBV was 87.5%, and 65.2% had good knowledge. Using the dose-count-derived analytic variable, 138 (39.3%) had received at least one vaccine dose (95% CI: 34.3–44.5%), while 46 (13.1%) reported three doses. Attitudes were favorable (84.3–87.7% agreement), but barriers were prominent, especially concerns about vaccine safety/effectiveness (72.1%), lack of vaccination services within or near the university (69.2%), lack of healthcare-worker encouragement (63.8%) and forgetfulness about subsequent doses (62.1%). In adjusted analysis, age <20 years (AOR 0.399), single marital status (AOR 0.183) and higher perceived barriers (AOR 0.593 per one-point increase) were associated with lower odds of vaccination. Improving uptake will require accessible campus vaccination, targeted safety communication, healthcare-worker engagement and reminder systems.

analysis.study_design_and_population: An analytical cross-sectional study was conducted among 351 consenting undergraduates during the 2025/2026 academic session at Al-Hikmah University, Ilorin, Nigeria.
analysis.methods: Data were analyzed using descriptive statistics, chi-square tests, independent-samples t-tests, and binary logistic regression.
analysis.main_results: Of 361 students who accessed the questionnaire, 351 consented and were analyzed. Awareness of HBV was 87.5%, and 65.2% had good knowledge. Using the dose-count-derived analytic variable, 138 (39.3%) had received at least one vaccine dose (95% CI: 34.3–44.5%), while 46 (13.1%) reported three doses. Favorable attitudes were noted, but prominent barriers included concerns about vaccine safety/effectiveness, lack of vaccination services, healthcare-worker encouragement, and forgetfulness.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: In adjusted analysis, age <20 years, single marital status, and higher perceived barriers were associated with lower odds of vaccination. The study highlights the need for accessible campus vaccination, targeted safety communication, healthcare-worker engagement, and reminder systems.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Improving uptake will require interventions such as accessible campus vaccination, targeted safety communication, healthcare-worker engagement, and reminder systems to address barriers and enhance vaccination rates among undergraduate students.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its cross-sectional design, which cannot establish causality. The sample size and response rate are also potential sources of bias. The findings suggest a need for further research to confirm these associations and to develop effective strategies for improving vaccination uptake.

analysis.summary_en: This study assessed hepatitis B vaccination uptake and identified associated determinants and barriers among undergraduate students at Al-Hikmah University, Ilorin, Nigeria. Of 351 students analyzed, 39.3% had received at least one vaccine dose, with barriers including concerns about vaccine safety and lack of healthcare-worker encouragement. The study highlights the need for accessible campus vaccination and targeted interventions.

papers.title_zh: 乙型肝炎疫苗接种率及其影响因素与障碍:尼日利亚伊洛林阿尔希克马大学本科生研究
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains an important preventable cause of chronic liver disease, cirrhosis and liver cancer. University students may remain susceptible when childhood vaccination was missed or incomplete, yet institution-specific evidence on vaccination behavior is limited. This study assessed hepatitis B vaccination uptake and identified associated determinants and perceived barriers among undergraduate students at Al-Hikmah University, Ilorin, Nigeria. An analytical cross-sectional study was conducted among consenting undergraduates during the 2025/2026 academic session. A structured electronic questionnaire assessed sociodemographic characteristics, HBV knowledge, vaccination history, attitudes, Health Belief Model constructs, information sources and barriers. Data were analyzed using descriptive statistics, chi-square tests, independent-samples t-tests and binary logistic regression. Of 361 students who accessed the questionnaire, 351 consented and were analyzed. Awareness of HBV was 87.5%, and 65.2% had good knowledge. Using the dose-count-derived analytic variable, 138 (39.3%) had received at least one vaccine dose (95% CI: 34.3–44.5%), while 46 (13.1%) reported three doses. Attitudes were favorable (84.3–87.7% agreement), but barriers were prominent, especially concerns about vaccine safety/effectiveness (72.1%), lack of vaccination services within or near the university (69.2%), lack of healthcare-worker encouragement (63.8%) and forgetfulness about subsequent doses (62.1%). In adjusted analysis, age <20 years (AOR 0.399), single marital status (AOR 0.183) and higher perceived barriers (AOR 0.593 per one-point increase) were associated with lower odds of vaccination. Improving uptake will require accessible campus vaccination, targeted safety communication, healthcare-worker engagement and reminder systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)感染仍然是慢性肝病、肝硬化和肝癌的重要可预防原因。当儿童时期疫苗接种未完成或缺失时,大学学生可能仍具有易感性,但关于机构特定疫苗接种行为的证据有限。本研究评估了乙型肝炎疫苗接种在尼日利亚伊洛林阿尔希克马大学本科生中的接种情况,并确定了相关的影响因素和感知障碍。在2025/2026学年期间,对同意参与的本科生进行了分析性横断面研究。通过结构化的电子问卷评估了社会人口学特征、HBV知识、疫苗接种接种史、态度、健康信念模型构念、信息来源和障碍。数据使用描述性统计、卡方检验、独立样本t检验和二元逻辑回归进行分析。在361名访问问卷的学生中,有351名同意并被纳入分析。HBV知晓率为87.5%,其中65.2%具有良好的知识。使用剂量计数衍生的分析变量,138名(39.3%)学生至少接种了一剂疫苗(95% CI: 34.3–44.5%),而46名(13.1%)报告接种了三剂。态度总体积极(84.3–87.7%同意),但障碍显著,尤其是对疫苗安全性和有效性的担忧(72.1%)、大学内或附近缺乏疫苗接种服务(69.2%)、缺乏医护人员鼓励(63.8%)以及对后续剂量的遗忘(62.1%)。在调整分析中,年龄小于20岁(AOR 0.399)、单身状态(AOR 0.183)以及更高的感知障碍(每增加一点AOR 0.593)与较低的疫苗接种接种率相关。提高接种率需要可及的校园疫苗接种服务、针对性的安全信息传播、医护人员参与以及提醒系统。

papers.title: Realizing personalized prediction for the reversal of chronic hepatitis B-associated liver fibrosis through machine learning
papers.abstract: Although long-term antiviral therapy can reverse liver fibrosis in a considerable proportion of patients with chronic hepatitis B, treatment response differs markedly among individuals, and reliable methods for predicting who will benefit remain lacking. Conventional clinical tools such as liver stiffness measurement and the aspartate aminotransferase-to-platelet ratio index were originally dewsigned for cross-sectional staging rather than longitudinal prediction, and their ability to capture the dynamic process of fibrosis reversal is limited. In this opinion review, we discuss how machine learning (ML) may help address this unmet need. We focus on three areas where ML has shown early but encouraging results: Quantitative analysis of images using ML, integration of pathological and clinical data through multimodal models, and dynamic prediction of treatment response based on serial measurements during antiviral therapy. In our view, the greatest value of ML lies not in replacing existing assessment tools but in complementing them, particularly through the early identification of patients who are unlikely to achieve fibrosis reversal with antiviral therapy alone. However, we also caution that most current models have been developed from small, single-center retrospective cohorts, and their clinical adoption will require prospective multi-center validation, improved model interpretability, and adherence to standardized reporting frameworks.

analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings suggest that machine learning could enhance surveillance and personalized treatment strategies for chronic hepatitis B, improving the prediction of fibrosis reversal and guiding clinical decisions.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the potential of machine learning to improve the prediction of liver fibrosis reversal in chronic hepatitis B patients. It highlights the limitations of conventional clinical tools in capturing dynamic fibrosis processes and emphasizes the need for more robust models. The authors argue that machine learning can complement existing methods by identifying patients who may not benefit from antiviral therapy alone. While the study is an opinion review, it suggests that integrating clinical and pathological data through machine learning could enhance surveillance and treatment strategies. The evidence is based on existing models, which are limited by their derivation from small, single-center cohorts. The findings indicate that machine learning may offer new insights into personalized prediction but require further validation for broader clinical application.
