elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述旨在评估 MAFLD 对 抗病毒药物 治疗 反应和 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 患者长期临床结果的影响。核心问题是 MAFLD 是否影响 CHB 患者对 抗病毒药物 治疗的病毒学、生化和临床反应。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本次系统评价和荟萃分析遵循 PRISMA 指南。证据基础包括来自 PubMed、Cochrane 图书馆、EMBASE 和 Web of Science 的截至 2025 年 11 月 30 日发表的研究。基于 抗病毒药物 方案和 MAFLD 诊断方法进行亚组分析,并进行留一敏感性分析以评估研究结果的稳健性。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: MAFLD 与较低的病毒学和生化反应率、第 48 周时乙型肝炎表面抗原血清清除的几率较高(特别是在接受核苷(酸)类似物治疗的患者中)以及尽管接受 抗病毒药物 治疗但发生肝细胞癌(HCC)的几率增加有关。然而,在任何时间点均未观察到 MAFLD 与乙型肝炎 e 抗原血清清除之间存在显着关联。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 亚组分析表明,抗病毒药物 方案和 MAFLD 诊断方法部分解释了总体结果的异质性,特别是 乙型肝炎病毒 DNA 清除率和 HCC 方面。证据没有报告 MAFLD 与这些结果相关的具体机制,也没有报告 MAFLD 对其他临床结果(如肝纤维化进展)的影响。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 研究结果支持将代谢风险评估纳入慢性乙型肝炎的管理,并强调需要对 MAFLD 和代谢功能障碍相关的脂肪性肝病进行标准化定义。

analysis_en.scope_and_question: The review aims to evaluate the impact of MAFLD on antiviral treatment responses and long-term clinical outcomes in patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB). The central question is whether MAFLD influences virological, biochemical, and clinical responses to antiviral therapy in CHB.
analysis_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: This systematic review and meta-analysis followed the PRISMA guidelines. The evidence base included studies from PubMed, the Cochrane Library, EMBASE, and Web of Science, published up to November 30, 2025. Subgroup analyses were conducted based on antiviral regimen and MAFLD diagnostic approach, and leave-one-out sensitivity analyses were performed to assess the robustness of findings.
analysis_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: MAFLD was associated with lower virological and biochemical response rates, higher odds of hepatitis B surface antigen seroclearance at week 48, particularly among patients receiving nucleos(t)ide analogue therapy, and increased odds of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) despite antiviral therapy. However, no significant association was observed between MAFLD and hepatitis B e antigen seroclearance at any time-point.
analysis_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: Subgroup analyses suggested that antiviral regimen and MAFLD diagnostic approach partly explained the heterogeneity in the overall findings, particularly for hepatitis B virus DNA clearance and HCC. The evidence does not report on the specific mechanisms linking MAFLD to these outcomes or the impact of MAFLD on other clinical outcomes such as liver fibrosis progression.
analysis_en.research_and_practice_implications: The findings support the integration of metabolic risk assessment in the management of CHB and highlight the need for standardized definitions of MAFLD and metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease.

papers.title_zh: 慢性乙型肝炎 中代谢功能障碍相关的脂肪肝和 抗病毒药物 反应:系统评价和荟萃分析
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND Metabolic dysfunction-associated fatty liver disease (MAFLD) frequently coexists with chronic hepatitis B (CHB). However, its association with antiviral treatment responses and long-term clinical outcomes in patients with CHB remains unclear. AIM To systematically evaluate the impact of MAFLD on antiviral treatment responses and long-term clinical outcomes in patients with CHB. METHODS This systematic review and meta-analysis was conducted in accordance with the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses guidelines. PubMed, the Cochrane Library, EMBASE, and Web of Science were searched for studies published up to November 30, 2025. Meta-analyses were performed to assess associations between MAFLD and antiviral treatment responses or clinical outcomes. Subgroup analyses were conducted according to antiviral regimen and MAFLD diagnostic approach, and leave-one-out sensitivity analyses were performed to evaluate robustness. RESULTS Thirty-two studies were included, of which 20 evaluated antiviral treatment efficacy and 13 assessed clinical outcomes in patients with CHB and concomitant MAFLD (one study reported both treatment responses and clinical outcomes). MAFLD was associated with a higher rate of hepatitis B surface antigen seroclearance at 48 weeks [odds ratio (OR) = 1.41, 95%CI: 1.28-1.55], although this association was attenuated at 96 weeks (OR = 1.44, 95%CI: 0.96-2.16). No significant association was observed between MAFLD and hepatitis B e antigen seroclearance at any time-point. MAFLD was consistently associated with lower rates of alanine aminotransferase normalization and hepatitis B virus DNA clearance throughout the treatment duration. MAFLD was associated with a significantly increased risk of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) despite antiviral therapy (OR = 1.50, 95%CI: 1.01-2.24). Subgroup analyses according to the antiviral regimen revealed distinct patterns, partly explaining the heterogeneity in the overall analyses. Subgroup analyses suggested that the antiviral regimen and MAFLD diagnostic approach partly explained the heterogeneity, particularly for hepatitis B virus DNA clearance and HCC. CONCLUSION MAFLD was associated with lower virological and biochemical response rates, higher odds of hepatitis B surface antigen seroclearance at week 48, particularly among patients receiving nucleos(t)ide analogue therapy, and higher odds of HCC in patients with CHB, but not with hepatitis B e antigen seroclearance. These findings support metabolic risk assessment in CHB management and highlight the need for standardized MAFLD/metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease definitions.

papers.title: Multicomponent Interventions to Improve Hepatitis B Vaccination Uptake Among Double-Negative Population
papers.abstract: A substantial proportion of individuals identified through hepatitis B screening are double-negative (HBsAg-negative and anti-HBs-negative) and remain fully susceptible to hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection despite the availability of an effective vaccine. PubMed, Web of Science, and CNKI were searched for literature published between January 2000 and December 2025 on barriers to HBV vaccination in double-negative populations and the interventions addressing them. Barriers operate at individual (knowledge deficits, vaccine hesitancy), service delivery (geographic inaccessibility, financial burden, disconnected screening-to-vaccination pathways), and policy (weak provider incentives, insufficient cross-sector coordination) levels. Reported interventions comprise patient-oriented strategies (reminder and recall, Health Belief Model- and Theory of Planned Behavior-based education, community engagement), provider-oriented approaches (clinical decision support, vaccination incentives, Plan-Do-Study-Act cycles), and policy-level measures (controlled temperature chain, pay-it-forward, service decentralization). Multicomponent bundles may be complementary and produce greater effects than single components; however, direct head-to-head evidence in the double-negative population is limited. Double-negative status is a convergent end-point phenotype of three immunological trajectories (never-vaccinated, vaccine non-responders, and waned immunity), and interventions should therefore be stratified accordingly. A “Screening-Education-Vaccination-Follow-up” framework is proposed, and pragmatic cluster-randomized trials with nested cost-effectiveness analyses should be prioritized.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 通过乙型肝炎筛查发现的很大一部分个体是双阴性(HBsAg 阴性和抗 HBs 阴性),并且尽管存在有效的 疫苗,但仍然完全容易受到 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染。该研究旨在解决双阴性人群中 HBV 疫苗接种 的障碍以及解决这些障碍的干预措施。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 检索了 PubMed、Web of Science 和 CNKI 2000 年 1 月至 2025 年 12 月期间发表的有关双阴性人群中 HBV 疫苗接种 障碍及其干预措施的文献。
elements_zh.methods: 障碍存在于个人(知识匮乏、疫苗 犹豫)、服务提供(地理不便、财务负担、筛选到 疫苗接种 路径的断开)和政策(提供者激励薄弱、跨部门协调不足)层面。
elements_zh.main_results: 报告的干预措施包括以患者为导向的策略(提醒和回忆、基于健康信念模型和计划行为理论的教育、社区参与)、以提供者为导向的方法(临床决策支持、疫苗接种激励、计划-实施-研究-行动周期)和政策层面的措施(控制温度链、向前支付、服务分散化)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 多组件捆绑可能是互补的,并且比单一组件产生更大的效果;然而,双阴性人群的直接直接证据有限。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 双阴性状态是三种免疫轨迹(从未接种疫苗、疫苗 无应答者和免疫力减弱)的趋同终点表型,因此应相应地对干预措施进行分层。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 提出了“筛选-教育-疫苗接种-随访”框架,并应优先考虑具有嵌套成本效益分析的实用整群随机试验。

papers.title_zh: 改善双阴性人群乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 摄取的多成分干预措施
papers.source_body_en: A substantial proportion of individuals identified through hepatitis B screening are double-negative (HBsAg-negative and anti-HBs-negative) and remain fully susceptible to hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection despite the availability of an effective vaccine. PubMed, Web of Science, and CNKI were searched for literature published between January 2000 and December 2025 on barriers to HBV vaccination in double-negative populations and the interventions addressing them. Barriers operate at individual (knowledge deficits, vaccine hesitancy), service delivery (geographic inaccessibility, financial burden, disconnected screening-to-vaccination pathways), and policy (weak provider incentives, insufficient cross-sector coordination) levels. Reported interventions comprise patient-oriented strategies (reminder and recall, Health Belief Model- and Theory of Planned Behavior-based education, community engagement), provider-oriented approaches (clinical decision support, vaccination incentives, Plan-Do-Study-Act cycles), and policy-level measures (controlled temperature chain, pay-it-forward, service decentralization). Multicomponent bundles may be complementary and produce greater effects than single components; however, direct head-to-head evidence in the double-negative population is limited. Double-negative status is a convergent end-point phenotype of three immunological trajectories (never-vaccinated, vaccine non-responders, and waned immunity), and interventions should therefore be stratified accordingly. A “Screening-Education-Vaccination-Follow-up” framework is proposed, and pragmatic cluster-randomized trials with nested cost-effectiveness analyses should be prioritized.

papers.title: Synthetic Biology in the Design and Development of Virus-Like Particle Vaccines
papers.abstract: With the frequent emergence of new infectious diseases and the growing demand for precision medicine, the limitations of traditional vaccines are becoming increasingly apparent. Virus-like particles (VLPs) have become a key platform for the development of next-generation vaccines due to their combination of structural characteristics typical of natural viruses and a favorable safety profile. From the perspective of synthetic biology, this article reviews the working principles, production processes, and key construction technologies of VLP vaccines, with a focus on research progress regarding chassis protein design, engineering modification of antigen modules, optimization of linkage systems, and enhancement of structural stability. Meanwhile, the development status of marketed VLP vaccines, such as those for hepatitis B virus (HBV), hepatitis E virus (HEV), and human papillomavirus (HPV) is summarized, and the application of VLP vaccines currently in clinical research, including those for influenza, COVID-19, and HIV is analyzed. The results demonstrate that synthetic biology has significantly enhanced the programmability, immunogenicity, and development efficiency of VLP vaccines, driving their evolution toward multivalent, intelligent, and personalized forms. However, issues such as complex antigen display, large-scale production, and the evaluation of long-term protective efficacy remain to be addressed. Future research could further integrate AI-driven protein design, novel expression systems, and precision delivery technologies to advance the clinical translation and industrial application of VLP vaccines.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the role of synthetic biology in the design and development of virus-like particle (VLP) vaccines, with a focus on hepatitis B virus (HBV). It outlines the working principles, production processes, and key technologies used in VLP vaccine development, emphasizing progress in chassis protein design, antigen module engineering, linkage system optimization, and structural stability enhancement. The review summarizes the development status of marketed HBV VLP vaccines and analyzes their application in clinical research. It highlights the significant improvements in VLP vaccine programmability, immunogenicity, and development efficiency achieved through synthetic biology. However, it also identifies unresolved challenges, including complex antigen display, large-scale production, and the evaluation of long-term protective efficacy. The review suggests future research directions that involve integrating AI-driven protein design, novel expression systems, and precision delivery technologies to further advance the clinical and industrial applications of VLP vaccines for HBV.

papers.title_zh: 合成生物学在病毒样颗粒设计和开发中的应用 疫苗
papers.source_body_en: With the frequent emergence of new infectious diseases and the growing demand for precision medicine, the limitations of traditional vaccines are becoming increasingly apparent. Virus-like particles (VLPs) have become a key platform for the development of next-generation vaccines due to their combination of structural characteristics typical of natural viruses and a favorable safety profile. From the perspective of synthetic biology, this article reviews the working principles, production processes, and key construction technologies of VLP vaccines, with a focus on research progress regarding chassis protein design, engineering modification of antigen modules, optimization of linkage systems, and enhancement of structural stability. Meanwhile, the development status of marketed VLP vaccines, such as those for hepatitis B virus (HBV), hepatitis E virus (HEV), and human papillomavirus (HPV) is summarized, and the application of VLP vaccines currently in clinical research, including those for influenza, COVID-19, and HIV is analyzed. The results demonstrate that synthetic biology has significantly enhanced the programmability, immunogenicity, and development efficiency of VLP vaccines, driving their evolution toward multivalent, intelligent, and personalized forms. However, issues such as complex antigen display, large-scale production, and the evaluation of long-term protective efficacy remain to be addressed. Future research could further integrate AI-driven protein design, novel expression systems, and precision delivery technologies to advance the clinical translation and industrial application of VLP vaccines.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着新发传染病的频繁出现和精准医疗需求的不断增长,传统疫苗的局限性日益显现。病毒样颗粒(VLP)由于结合了天然病毒的典型结构特征和良好的安全性,已成为开发下一代 疫苗 的关键平台。本文从合成生物学的角度,综述了VLP 疫苗的工作原理、生产工艺和关键构建技术,重点介绍了底盘蛋白设计、抗原模块工程化改造、连锁系统优化、结构稳定性增强等方面的研究进展。同时,对已上市的病毒颗粒疫苗(HBV)、戊型肝炎病毒(HEV)、人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)等的开发现状进行了总结,并分析了病毒颗粒疫苗目前在流感、COVID-19、HIV等临床研究中的应用情况。结果表明,合成生物学显着增强了VLP 疫苗的可编程性、免疫原性和开发效率,推动其进化走向多价、智能和个性化形式。然而,复杂抗原展示、大规模生产以及长期保护功效评估等问题仍有待解决。未来的研究可以进一步整合人工智能驱动的蛋白质设计、新型表达系统和精准递送技术,以推进VLP 疫苗的临床转化和工业应用。

papers.title: Adoptive Immune Transfer in the Functional Cure of Chronic Hepatitis B: Insights from Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation
papers.abstract: Achieving a functional cure for chronic hepatitis B remains challenging, primarily due to the inability to reconstitute effective host immune responses against the virus. The unexpected functional cure of chronic hepatitis B following allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation provides a unique proof-of-principle model for immune-mediated HBsAg clearance. This review aims to elucidate that the core mechanism underlying hematopoietic stem cell transplantation-mediated HBsAg clearance lies in “adoptive immune transfer”, and to explore design principles and future directions for modern cell-based immunotherapies based on this mechanism. We reviewed available case reports and meta-analytic evidence, acknowledging their limitations, and dissected the immunological mechanisms by which donor-derived hepatitis B virus-specific T and B cells may jointly reconstitute adaptive immunity and break host immune tolerance. We then comparatively evaluated the technical characteristics and limitations of chimeric antigen receptor T cell therapy and T-cell receptor-engineered T-cell therapy. Current engineered T-cell therapies, while translating the core principle of adoptive transfer, exhibit fundamental limitations including monoclonal specificity, inability to remodel the host microenvironment, and absence of durable humoral reconstitution. A broader functional-cure strategy may require adopting the paradigm of synergy and systemic immune reshaping exemplified by hematopoietic stem cell transplantation. Future strategies should develop temporally optimized, multilayered combination therapies, offering a possible pathway for next-generation therapeutics capable of systemically rebuilding antiviral immunity.

papers.title: Hepatitis C seroprevalence and its association with injecting drug use among people who use drugs in the West Bank, Palestine: a retrospective cross-sectional study.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: People who use drugs (PWUD) are at increased risk of blood-borne viral infections. Evidence on hepatitis C virus (HCV), hepatitis B virus (HBV), and human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) among PWUD in Palestine is limited. This study determined the seroprevalence of HCV, HBV, and HIV among PWUD attending governmental substance use disorder (SUD) treatment centers in the West Bank. METHODS: This retrospective cross-sectional study included 397 PWUD in SUD treatment centers in the West Bank during 2019-2023. Serological results for anti-HCV, HBsAg, and anti-HIV were obtained from routine clinical records. Crude and adjusted prevalence ratios (PRs) for the association between injecting drug use and anti-HCV seropositivity were estimated using modified Poisson regression. RESULTS: HCV seroprevalence was 23.0%, HBsAg prevalence was 2.0%, and no HIV was detected. HCV seroprevalence was 55.4% among injecting versus 6.7% among non-injecting users. After adjustment for age, education, employment status, and previous treatment attempts, injecting drug use remained strongly associated with HCV seropositivity (adjusted PR = 6.43, 95% CI 3.82-10.82). HCV prevalence increased with longer duration of drug use (p for trend <0.001), and varied significantly across governorates. CONCLUSIONS: HCV is the predominant infection among PWUD receiving SUD treatment in the West Bank, whereas HBV prevalence was low and HIV was not detected. Injecting drug use was strongly associated with HCV seropositivity, and prevalence increased with longer duration of drug use. Integrating HCV screening, RNA testing, antiviral treatment, and harm-reduction policies into SUD services is essential to achieve the WHO 2030 hepatitis elimination targets.

papers.title: Pegylated interferon α-2b add-on to nucleos(t)ide analogues reduces hepatocellular carcinoma and decompensation in advanced fibrotic chronic hepatitis B
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND The current therapeutic strategy of adding pegylated interferon (Peg-IFN) α-2b to nucleos(t)ide analogues (NAs) is primarily aimed at achieving functional cure. However, its value in improving prognosis and the suitable candidates for this combination strategy in patients with hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related advanced fibrosis or compensated cirrhosis remain to be further explored. AIM To evaluate the long-term prognosis benefit of add-on Peg-IFNα-2b therapy in patients with HBV-related advanced fibrosis or compensated cirrhosis. METHODS This retrospective cohort study enrolled patients diagnosed with HBV-related advanced fibrosis or compensated cirrhosis. Participants were divided into two groups: (1) Those receiving combination therapy (Peg-IFNα-2b add-on to ongoing NA treatment); and (2) Those receiving NA monotherapy. A 1:1 propensity score matching approach was applied to balance baseline characteristics between groups. In survival analysis, the outcomes of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and decompensated cirrhosis were stratified by baseline clinical features and established HCC risk scores. RESULTS The analysis included 302 matched pairs, with a median follow-up duration of 220 weeks. Combination therapy was associated with a significantly lower risk of developing HCC (hazard ratio = 0.22; 95%CI: 0.11-0.48) and decompensated cirrhosis (hazard ratio = 0.39; 95%CI: 0.20-0.77) than NA monotherapy. These benefits were particularly pronounced among patients classified as intermediate-to-high risk by validated HCC prediction models and in those with persistent biochemical abnormalities lasting > 12 months. CONCLUSION Add-on therapy with Peg-IFNα-2b to NAs is significantly associated with reduced HCC and decompensation in high-risk patients with HBV-related advanced fibrosis or cirrhosis, supporting its use in this population.

papers.title: Knowledge, Attitude and Practices regarding Hepatitis B Infection and Vaccination among Healthcare Workers in a Tertiary Care Hospital in Bangalore, Karnataka
papers.abstract: Background: Hepatitis B, although a vaccine preventable disease, is one of the leading causes of mortality worldwide. The prevalence is four folds higher among healthcare workers (HCW). Therefore, the objective of this study was to assess and compare the KAP towards Hepatitis B vaccination among different groups of healthcare workers in a tertiary hospital. Methods: Cross-sectional survey was conducted with a questionnaire to gather information from different groups of healthcare workers which included doctors, nurses, dentists and lab technicians in a tertiary hospital in Bangalore, Karnataka. The data collected was coded and analyzed using SPSS software version 23. ANOVA was then used for finding the mean difference between the groups. Results: This cross-sectional study included N = 121 healthcare professionals (doctors n = 31, dental surgeons n = 30, nurses n = 30, lab technicians n = 30). Demographic variables were also stratified by professional groups to minimize confounding. Chi-square test showed no significant difference in gender or age distribution across groups (p > 0.05). Moreover, one-way ANOVA demonstrated statistically significant differences in knowledge, attitude, practice, and total KAP scores across professional groups (p 0.05). In addition, effect size analysis showed moderate-to-large effects, with professional category explaining 16% variance in knowledge, 21% in attitude, 9% in practice, and 24% in total KAP scores. Conclusion: The study showed KAP gap in HCW’s regarding hepatitis B, and more so in paramedical workers. This gap needs to be filled with the creation of a central database, regular reminders for vaccination, strengthening of the HICC, and waste disposal guidance to HCWs.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to assess and compare knowledge, attitude, and practices (KAP) regarding Hepatitis B vaccination among different groups of healthcare workers in a tertiary hospital in Bangalore, Karnataka. A cross-sectional survey was conducted using a questionnaire, and data were analyzed with SPSS software and ANOVA. The study included 121 healthcare professionals, with significant differences observed in KAP scores across professional groups. The findings highlight a gap in KAP among healthcare workers, particularly in paramedical roles, and suggest the need for targeted interventions such as a central database, vaccination reminders, and improved health information and communication (HICC) practices. The study's limitations include the stratification of demographic variables by professional groups to minimize confounding, which may affect the generalizability of the results. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the observational nature of the study and the potential for confounding factors.

papers.title: Histological differences between patients with porto-sinusoidal vascular disorder and fibrosis regression of chronic hepatitis B: an analysis based on machine learning algorithms
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Porto-sinusoidal vascular disorder (PSVD) alters portal hemodynamics, leading to portal hypertension without obvious fibrosis. Incomplete septal fibrosis (ISF) is recognized as one of the pathological hallmarks of PSVD; however, the differences in ISF between patients with PSVD and those with fibrosis regression remain controversial. This study aimed to analyze the vascular and fibrotic characteristics of liver biopsies between two cohorts using machine learning algorithms. Methods 41 patients with PSVD and 40 with chronic hepatitis B who achieved fibrosis regression after 48 weeks of entecavir treatment were enrolled. The fibrosis stage was assessed using the Ishak system. Images of unstained liver biopsy slides were obtained using second-harmonic generation/two-photon excited fluorescence. Machine learning algorithms were adopted for the analysis: arterial density (AD), portal vein density (PVD), central vein density (CVD), collagen proportionate area (CPA), and different areas of CPA on the portal area, zones 1/2/3, and ISF. Results In contrast to fibrosis regression, patients with PSVD had significantly higher AD (17.98 ± 10.38/mm2 vs 8.59 ± 8.28/mm2, P

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to analyze the vascular and fibrotic characteristics of liver biopsies between patients with porto-sinusoidal vascular disorder (PSVD) and those with fibrosis regression of chronic hepatitis B using machine learning algorithms. The study enrolled 41 PSVD patients and 40 chronic hepatitis B patients who achieved fibrosis regression after 48 weeks of entecavir treatment. The fibrosis stage was assessed using the Ishak system, and images of unstained liver biopsy slides were obtained using second-harmonic generation/two-photon excited fluorescence. The machine learning algorithms analyzed arterial density, portal vein density, central vein density, collagen proportionate area, and different areas of CPA on the portal area, zones 1/2/3, and ISF. The results indicated that patients with PSVD had significantly higher arterial density compared to those with fibrosis regression. The authors interpreted these findings as highlighting distinct vascular and fibrotic patterns in PSVD, which may inform more precise diagnostic approaches. The study's findings may contribute to the development of better diagnostic tools for differentiating PSVD from fibrosis regression in chronic hepatitis B patients. However, the study is limited by its abstract-only nature and potential biases in sample selection, which may affect the generalizability of the results. The evidence is considered moderate in strength due to the lack of detailed statistical analysis and outcome reporting.

papers.title: Hepatitis B Awareness and Recent Testing Among Women in Nigeria: Analysis of the 2024 Demographic and Health Survey
papers.abstract: Introduction: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) is hyperendemic in Nigeria, but national data on HBV awareness and testing among women of reproductive age are lacking. Methods: We analysed data from 38,647 women aged 15–49 years in the 2024 Nigeria Demographic and Health Survey. We estimated survey-weighted prevalence of having heard of HBV (awareness), recent (12-month) testing among aware women, and recent testing among all women, and fitted survey-weighted logistic and multinomial regression models. Results: Awareness was 53.3% (95% CI 52.1–54.6). Among aware women, 12.9% (95% CI 12.1–13.7) had been recently tested, equivalent to 6.9% (95% CI 6.4–7.4) of all women. Higher education, greater wealth and health insurance were associated with both outcomes; women in the richest quintile had higher odds of recent testing than those in the poorest (adjusted odds ratio 3.29, 95% CI 2.31–4.68), and the wealth gradient was steeper for testing than for awareness on the relative scale. Recent testing among all women was lowest in the South South (5.0%) and North West (5.4%). The North West reported the highest awareness (66.5%), but almost all interviews there were in Hausa, and this estimate may partly reflect recognition of a translated term rather than of HBV itself. Socioeconomic gradients in both outcomes differed significantly by zone. Conclusions: HBV testing lags far behind awareness and is concentrated among more advantaged women. Zonal awareness estimates, particularly for the North West, should be interpreted with caution. Because the data are cross-sectional and self-reported, these associations are not causal. Approaches that make HBV testing routinely available and affordable, particularly within antenatal care, warrant evaluation.

papers.title_original: Predicting hepatitis B virus DNA elevation during pregnancy: Toward risk-stratified monitoring beyond the traditional viral-load threshold

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the limitations of traditional viral-load thresholds in predicting hepatitis B virus (HBV) DNA elevation during pregnancy, highlighting the need for improved risk-stratified monitoring to better manage maternal and fetal health.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was a retrospective analysis conducted in Ethiopia, focusing on maternal HBV DNA levels and their association with elevation during mid-to-late pregnancy. It involved a moderate-sized dataset and did not include external validation.
analysis.methods: The researchers developed a model using maternal age and baseline HBV DNA levels ≥ 100 international units per milliliter to predict DNA elevation during pregnancy. The model was based on existing data and did not involve prospective testing or external validation.
analysis.main_results: Maternal age and baseline HBV DNA ≥ 100 international units per milliliter were found to predict mid-to-late pregnancy elevation. However, the model could not predict transmission, maternal flares, or treatment needs.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted their findings as a step toward risk-stratified monitoring, suggesting that dynamic surveillance could improve timely antiviral prophylaxis and reduce mother-to-child transmission. This approach is novel in its focus on predictive modeling beyond traditional viral-load thresholds.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings may inform more targeted antenatal surveillance strategies for HBV-infected pregnant women, potentially improving outcomes by enabling earlier interventions and reducing the risk of mother-to-child transmission.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's retrospective design, lack of external validation, and moderate performance limit its applicability for clinical decision-making. The evidence is moderate in strength due to these constraints.

analysis.summary_en: This study explores the use of predictive modeling to identify factors associated with hepatitis B virus (HBV) DNA elevation during pregnancy, aiming to move beyond traditional viral-load thresholds. The authors found that maternal age and baseline HBV DNA levels ≥ 100 international units per milliliter could predict elevation in mid-to-late pregnancy. However, the model cannot predict transmission, maternal flares, or treatment needs. papers.title: CD161-lectin-like transcript 1 axis beyond programmed cell death protein 1 in hepatitis B virus-associated hepatocellular carcinoma
papers.abstract: Hepatitis B virus (HBV)-associated hepatocellular carcinoma develops in a chronically inflamed, tolerogenic liver microenvironment. In this setting, T-cell dysfunction limits the efficacy of programmed death-1 (PD-1) blockade. Emerging evidence from Liu et al published in the World Journal of Gastrointestinal Oncology suggests that CD161 may represent an additional inhibitory axis within exhausted CD8+ T cells that is not fully captured by the PD-1/ programmed death ligand-1 pathway. In their study, CD161+CD8+ T cells were enriched in tumor tissue, and CD161 expression persisted even as PD-1+ compartments contracted after PD-1 inhibition, suggesting that CD161-mediated restraint may remain active under therapeutic pressure. Mechanistically, sustained engagement of the CD161-lectin-like transcript 1 interaction may impair T-cell effector function and contribute to adaptive immune resistance in the HBV-infected liver. These findings highlight the importance of protein-level assessment of CD161 and parallel evaluation with PD-1 to accurately characterize immune inhibition. Key knowledge gaps include the cellular source of lectin-like transcript 1 within the tumor microenvironment, the influence of ongoing HBV virological activity on CD161+ T-cell subsets, and the identification of clinically meaningful progression endpoints. In this editorial, we place these findings in mechanistic and translational context, highlighting the potential role of the CD161-lectin-like transcript 1 axis as a complementary pathway of immune resistance beyond PD-1 blockade. Collectively, the current evidence supports a cautious, hypothesis-driven translational strategy to evaluate combined modulation of the CD161 and PD-1 axes in carefully selected patients with HBV-associated hepatocellular carcinoma.

papers.title_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒 相关肝细胞癌中 CD161 凝集素样转录物 1 轴超出程序性细胞死亡蛋白 1
papers.source_body_en: Hepatitis B virus (HBV)-associated hepatocellular carcinoma develops in a chronically inflamed, tolerogenic liver microenvironment. In this setting, T-cell dysfunction limits the efficacy of programmed death-1 (PD-1) blockade. Emerging evidence from Liu et al published in the World Journal of Gastrointestinal Oncology suggests that CD161 may represent an additional inhibitory axis within exhausted CD8+ T cells that is not fully captured by the PD-1/ programmed death ligand-1 pathway. In their study, CD161+CD8+ T cells were enriched in tumor tissue, and CD161 expression persisted even as PD-1+ compartments contracted after PD-1 inhibition, suggesting that CD161-mediated restraint may remain active under therapeutic pressure. Mechanistically, sustained engagement of the CD161-lectin-like transcript 1 interaction may impair T-cell effector function and contribute to adaptive immune resistance in the HBV-infected liver. These findings highlight the importance of protein-level assessment of CD161 and parallel evaluation with PD-1 to accurately characterize immune inhibition. Key knowledge gaps include the cellular source of lectin-like transcript 1 within the tumor microenvironment, the influence of ongoing HBV virological activity on CD161+ T-cell subsets, and the identification of clinically meaningful progression endpoints. In this editorial, we place these findings in mechanistic and translational context, highlighting the potential role of the CD161-lectin-like transcript 1 axis as a complementary pathway of immune resistance beyond PD-1 blockade. Collectively, the current evidence supports a cautious, hypothesis-driven translational strategy to evaluate combined modulation of the CD161 and PD-1 axes in carefully selected patients with HBV-associated hepatocellular carcinoma.
papers.abstract_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 相关肝细胞癌在慢性炎症、耐受性肝脏微环境中发生。在这种情况下,T 细胞功能障碍限制了程序性死亡 1 (PD-1) 阻断的功效。Liu 等人发表在《世界胃肠肿瘤学杂志》上的新证据表明,CD161 可能代表耗尽的 CD8+ T 细胞内的另一个抑制轴,该轴未被 PD-1/程序性死亡配体-1 通路完全捕获。在他们的研究中,CD161+CD8+T细胞在肿瘤组织中富集,即使PD-1+区室在PD-1抑制后收缩,CD161表达仍然持续,这表明CD161介导的抑制可能在治疗压力下保持活跃。从机制上讲,CD161-凝集素样转录物 1 相互作用的持续参与可能会损害 T 细胞效应器功能,并有助于 HBV 感染肝脏中的适应性免疫抵抗。这些发现强调了 CD161 蛋白质水平评估和 PD-1 平行评估对于准确表征免疫抑制的重要性。关键知识差距包括肿瘤微环境中凝集素样转录物 1 的细胞来源、持续的 HBV 病毒学活性对 CD161+ T 细胞亚群的影响,以及临床有意义的进展终点的识别。在这篇社论中,我们将这些发现置于机制和转化背景中,强调了 CD161 凝集素样转录物 1 轴作为 PD-1 阻断之外的免疫抵抗的补充途径的潜在作用。总的来说,当前的证据支持谨慎的、假设驱动的转化策略,以评估精心挑选的 HBV 相关肝细胞癌患者中 CD161 和 PD-1 轴的联合调节。

papers.title: Defining the Structure-Activity Relationships of Thiazolide Antivirals: Balancing Potency, Metabolic Stability, and Aqueous Solubility.
papers.abstract: Recent studies on thiazolide antivirals have identified compounds RM5038 and RM5021 as potent inhibitors of hepatitis B virus (HBV), hepatitis C virus (HCV), and influenza A, although their development has been limited by poor aqueous solubility and rapid metabolic clearance. In this work, a series of novel halogen-substituted and 4'-alkylsulfone thiazolide analogs were synthesized using updated convergent synthetic approaches and flexible protecting group strategies. DMPK evaluation demonstrated that 3-X halogen substitution significantly improved aqueous solubility in parallel to enhancing metabolic stability. Within the chlorothiazolide series, compounds 10gand 10l displayed much improved metabolic stability profiles, excellent aqueous solubility representing a 10-fold improvement over the parent drug, together with low single-digit micromolar antiviral (influenza A) activity and acceptable in vitro safety indices. Evaluation of the 4'-alkylsulfone thiazolides also revealed improved in vitro DMPK profiles while retaining micromolar antiviral potency. SAR analysis indicated that short alkyl sulfone substituents containing two to three carbons are optimal for antiviral activity, while branched alkyl groups may provide additional metabolic advantages. In summary, compounds 10g, 10l, and 15d represent promising early leads for progression to in vivo profiling and additional preclinical evaluation.

analysis.methods: The researchers synthesized a series of halogen-substituted and 4'-alkylsulfone thiazolide analogs using updated convergent synthetic approaches and flexible protecting group strategies. They then evaluated the drugs' DMPK profiles and antiviral potency in vitro.
analysis.main_results: DMPK evaluation showed that 3-X halogen substitution significantly improved aqueous solubility and metabolic stability. analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings indicate that specific structural modifications can enhance the physicochemical properties of thiazolides without compromising their antiviral potency, offering a novel approach to drug design for HBV.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results provide a foundation for the development of more effective antiviral agents against HBV, potentially improving treatment options and reducing the limitations of current thiazolide drugs.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to in vitro evaluations, and the evidence is based on abstract-only data, which may not fully reflect in vivo efficacy or safety. The confidence in these findings is moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This study focuses on improving the physicochemical properties of thiazolide antivirals to enhance their therapeutic potential against hepatitis B virus (HBV). The researchers synthesized novel halogen-substituted and 4'-alkylsulfone thiazolide analogs using updated synthetic methods. DMPK evaluation revealed that 3-X halogen substitution significantly improved aqueous solubility and metabolic stability. Compounds 10g and 10l showed much improved metabolic stability, excellent aqueous solubility (10-fold improvement over the parent drug), and low single-digit micromolar antiviral activity against influenza A. The study also found that 4'-alkylsulfone thiazolides had improved in vitro DMPK profiles while retaining micromolar antiviral potency. SAR analysis suggested that short alkyl sulfone substituents are optimal for antiviral activity, while branched groups may offer additional metabolic benefits. The findings highlight a novel approach to drug design for HBV, but the study is limited to in vitro data, which may not fully represent in vivo performance. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the abstract-only nature of the data.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在解决开发噻唑化物 抗病毒药物 的挑战,该噻唑化物 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染的 治疗 具有更高的效力、代谢稳定性和水溶性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及新型噻唑烷类似物的合成及其 抗病毒药物 抗 HBV 活性的评估,重点是优化其理化性质。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员使用更新的聚合合成方法和灵活的保护基策略合成了一系列卤素取代的4'-烷基砜噻唑化物类似物。然后他们评估了药物的 DMPK 特征和 抗病毒药物 的体外效力。
elements_zh.main_results: DMPK评价表明,3-X卤素取代显着提高了水溶性和代谢稳定性。化合物 10g 和 10l 表现出大大改善的代谢稳定性、优异的水溶性(比母体药物提高 10 倍)以及针对甲型流感病毒的低个位数微摩尔 抗病毒药物 活性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,特定的结构修饰可以增强噻唑烷类化合物的理化性质,而不影响其 抗病毒药物 效力,为 HBV 药物设计提供了一种新方法。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为开发更有效的抗 HBV 的 抗病毒药物 药物奠定了基础,可能改善 治疗 的选择并减少当前噻唑类药物的局限性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于体外评估,证据仅基于摘要数据,可能无法完全反映体内疗效或安全性。这些发现的可信度是中等的。

papers.title: Engineered Exosomes Delivering FOSB siRNA Alleviate Podocyte Injury in Hepatitis B Virus-Associated Nephritis
papers.abstract: Abstract Hepatitis B virus-associated glomerulonephritis (HBV-GN) is the common extrahepatic manifestation of HBV infection and a major secondary glomerular disease in China. Upregulated FOSB mediates podocyte injury induced by HBx, whereas silencing FOSB can reverse this pathological change. Bone marrow mesenchymal stem cell-derived exosomes (BMSC-Exos) exhibit excellent biocompatibility, while their clinical application is limited by short circulating half-life and insufficient drug loading capacity. Herein, we constructed Cyclo(RGDfC)-modified BMSC-Exos encapsulated with FOSB siRNA and investigated its therapeutic potential against HBx-mediated podocyte damage. Transcriptomic analysis of renal samples from HBV-GN patients and healthy volunteers screened FOSB as a key pathogenic gene. We established an in vitro HBx-overexpressing podocyte model and an in vivo HBx transgenic mouse model. Engineered exosomes were prepared via covalent coupling of Cyclo(RGDfC) and siRNA loading, followed by comprehensive characterization. Our data verified that HBx induced FOSB overexpression. Cyclo(RGDfC)-modified engineered exosomes can be internalized by podocytes. Relative to unmodified exosomes, these constructs significantly downregulated FOSB, alleviated podocyte apoptosis and inflammatory response, and ameliorated renal lesions and dysfunction in transgenic mice. Collectively, Cyclo(RGDfC)-modified FOSB siRNA-loaded BMSC-Exos hinder HBV-GN progression through inhibiting FOSB-dependent podocyte injury, which represents a prospective therapeutic strategy for HBV-GN.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 乙型肝炎病毒相关性肾小球肾炎(HBV-GN)是HBV感染的重要肝外表现,也是我国主要的继发性肾小球疾病。该研究旨在通过针对 FOSB 介导的足细胞损伤来探索 HBV-GN 的新治疗策略。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及体外 HBx 过表达足细胞模型和体内 HBx 转基因小鼠模型。对 HBV-GN 患者和健康志愿者肾脏样本的转录组分析确定 FOSB 是关键致病基因。
elements_zh.methods: 通过 Cyclo(RGDfC) 和 siRNA 负载的共价偶联制备工程外泌体,然后进行综合表征。在体外和体内模型中研究了这些外泌体的治疗潜力。
elements_zh.main_results: 我们的数据证实 HBx 诱导 FOSB 过度表达。Cyclo(RGDfC)修饰的工程外泌体被足细胞内化,并显着下调 FOSB,减轻足细胞凋亡和炎症反应,并改善转基因小鼠的肾脏病变和功能障碍。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,传递 FOSB siRNA 的工程外泌体可以有效抑制 FOSB 依赖性足细胞损伤,为 HBV-GN 提供一种有前景的治疗策略。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为 HBV-GN 的 治疗 提供了一种潜在的新方法,可以为该疾病的未来研究和治疗开发提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 骨髓间充质干细胞来源的外泌体由于其循环半衰期短和载药能力不足,在临床应用中受到限制。然而,该研究的结果得到了体外和体内模型的支持,为工程外泌体的治疗潜力提供了一定的信心。

papers.title: Clonorchis sinensis co-infection potentiates polymorphonuclear-myeloid-derived suppressor cells expansion and metabolic reprogramming in chronic hepatitis B patients
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND Clonorchis sinensis (C. sinensis ) co-infection is known to accelerate disease progression and induce immune tolerance in patients with hepatitis B virus (HBV), particularly in regions where both infections are endemic. Metabolic reprogramming has emerged as a key driver of immunosuppression. These metabolic shifts are often orchestrated by myeloid-derived suppressor cells (MDSCs), which expand during chronic infections to promote immune tolerance. sinensis co-infection reprograms metabolism to favor MDSC-linked suppression and how this process relates to normal liver enzyme levels remains unclear. AIM To investigate whether C. sinensis co-infection induces MDSC- linked metabolic reprogramming in patients with HBV and normal liver enzyme levels. METHODS In this cross-sectional study, a total of 117 participants were enrolled and assigned to four groups: Healthy controls (n = 30), C. sinensis mono-infected participants (n = 29), HBV mono-infected participants (n = 28), and co-infected participants (n = 30). Serum cytokine profiles were measured using chemiluminescence immunoassay, amino acid metabolites using liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry, and MDSC subsets using flow cytometry. Spearman correlation and mediation analyses were performed to explore the relationships among inflammation, metabolism, and immunity. RESULTS HBV mono-infected and co-infected patients showed no statistically significant differences in liver enzyme and HBV DNA levels. However, compared with the HBV mono-infected group, the co-infected group had higher levels of the inflammatory cytokine: Interleukin-6 (IL-6) and tumor necrosis factor-α (TNF-α), accompanied by markedly lower interferon-γ (IFN-γ) levels. Flow cytometric assay revealed that polymorphonuclear MDSCs (PMN-MDSCs) showed the greatest expansion in the co-infected group, and their proportion correlated strongly with IL-6 and TNF-α levels. Metabolically, the co-infected group had a significantly higher ornithine-to-arginine ratio. Mediation analysis suggested that PMN-MDSCs accounted for approximately 45% of the total effect of IL-6 on IFN-γ suppression. sinensis co-infection was associated with immunosuppression through IL-6/TNF-α-linked PMN-MDSC expansion and elevated ornithine-to-arginine ratio, resulting in suppressed IFN-γ production despite normal liver enzyme levels.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在探讨华支睾吸虫合并感染是否会在肝酶水平正常的 HBV 患者中诱导 MDSC 相关的代谢重编程。背景强调,已知中华支原体合并感染会加速乙型肝炎患者的疾病进展并诱导免疫耐受,特别是在流行地区。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项横断面研究纳入了 117 名参与者,分为四组:健康对照(n = 30)、中华支原体单一感染参与者(n = 29)、HBV 单一感染参与者(n = 28)和混合感染参与者(n = 30)。
elements_zh.methods: 使用化学发光免疫测定法测量血清细胞因子谱,使用液相色谱-串联质谱法测量氨基酸代谢物,并使用流式细胞术测量MDSC子集。流式细胞术检测显示,多形核MDSC(PMN-MDSC)在共感染组中表现出最大的扩增,并且其比例与IL-6和TNF-α水平密切相关。
elements_zh.main_results: HBV单一感染和合并感染患者的肝酶和HBV DNA水平无统计学差异。然而,共同感染组的炎症细胞因子:白细胞介素-6 (IL-6) 和肿瘤坏死因子-α (TNF-α) 水平较高,同时干扰素-γ (IFN-γ) 水平明显较低。中介分析表明,PMN-MDSC 约占 IL-6 对 IFN-γ 抑制总效应的 45%。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,中华线虫合并感染与通过 IL-6/TNF-α 连接的 PMN-MDSC 扩增和鸟氨酸与精氨酸比率升高而产生的免疫抑制有关,导致尽管肝酶水平正常,但 IFN-γ 的产生受到抑制。这一发现强调了共感染可能调节 HBV 患者 免疫应答 的新机制。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能有助于了解合并感染 HBV 患者的免疫调节,并可能指导未来基于免疫的治疗和针对合并感染情况的 监测 策略的研究。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是横断面的,限制了其建立因果关系的能力。证据基于相关性和中介分析,可能无法完全捕捉感染与 免疫应答 之间复杂的相互作用。信心是中等的。

Flow cytometric assay revealed that polymorphonuclear MDSCs (PMN-MDSCs) showed the greatest expansion in the co-infected group, and their proportion correlated strongly with IL-6 and TNF-α levels. Metabolically, the co-infected group had a significantly higher ornithine-to-arginine ratio. Mediation analysis suggested that PMN-MDSCs accounted for approximately 45% of the total effect of IL-6 on IFN-γ suppression. sinensis co-infection was associated with immunosuppression through IL-6/TNF-α-linked PMN-MDSC expansion and elevated ornithine-to-arginine ratio, resulting in suppressed IFN-γ production despite normal liver enzyme levels.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在探讨华支睾吸虫合并感染是否会在肝酶水平正常的 HBV 患者中诱导 MDSC 相关的代谢重编程。背景强调,已知中华支原体合并感染会加速乙型肝炎患者的疾病进展并诱导免疫耐受,特别是在流行地区。

analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能有助于了解合并感染 HBV 患者的免疫调节,并可能指导未来基于免疫的治疗和针对合并感染情况的 监测 策略的研究。

papers.title: Interferon therapy reduces incidence of hepatocellular carcinoma in patients with high risk of hepatitis B virus-related hepatocellular carcinoma
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND The proportion of patients with hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is as high as 85.69% among HCC patients in China. Current anti-HBV drugs include nucleos(t)ide analogs (NAs) and interferon (IFN). AIM To compare the impact of NAs and IFN therapy on the occurrence of HCC in patients at high risk of HBV-related HCC. METHODS We enrolled 368 patients with high risk of HBV-related HCC, and 120 received subcutaneous injections of IFN, with or without NAs, constituting the IFN group. The remaining 248 patients were assigned to the NAs group, and received treatment with NAs alone. RESULTS For patients with a high risk of HBV-related HCC, after a 5-year treatment period, HCC incidence in the IFN group was 2.54%, while the NAs group showed a significantly higher incidence of 25.74% (P CONCLUSION IFN-based therapy, compared with NAs, significantly reduced the risk of HCC in patients with high risk of HBV-related HCC.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the high incidence of HBV-related hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) in China and evaluate the impact of interferon (IFN) therapy versus nucleos(t)ide analogs (NAs) on HCC occurrence in high-risk patients.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A retrospective cohort study was conducted on 368 patients with high risk of HBV-related HCC, with 120 patients receiving IFN therapy (with or without NAs) and 248 patients receiving NA therapy alone.
analysis.methods: Patients were enrolled and followed for a 5-year treatment period. HCC incidence was monitored and compared between the IFN group and the NAs group using statistical analysis to determine significance.
analysis.main_results: After 5 years of treatment, the HCC incidence in the IFN group was 2.54%, while the NAs group had a significantly higher incidence of 25.74% (P < 0.001).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted these findings as evidence that IFN-based therapy significantly reduces HCC risk compared to NAs alone in high-risk HBV patients, highlighting a novel therapeutic approach.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results suggest that IFN-based therapy could be a more effective option for reducing HCC incidence in patients at high risk of HBV-related HCC, potentially informing treatment guidelines and public health strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its retrospective design and potential for confounding factors, but the evidence is strong due to the clear comparison between IFN and NAs groups and the statistically significant results.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the impact of interferon (IFN) therapy versus nucleos(t)ide analogs (NAs) on hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) incidence in patients at high risk of HBV-related HCC. The research aimed to address the high prevalence of HBV-related HCC in China and evaluate therapeutic efficacy. A retrospective cohort study enrolled 368 patients, with 120 receiving IFN therapy and 248 receiving NA therapy alone. After 5 years, HCC incidence was 2.54% in the IFN group and 25.74% in the NAs group (P < 0.001). The authors concluded that IFN-based therapy significantly reduces HCC risk compared to NAs alone, offering a novel therapeutic approach. These findings may inform treatment guidelines for high-risk HBV patients. The study's retrospective design introduces potential limitations, but the results are robust due to the clear comparison and statistical significance.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在解决中国 HBV 相关肝细胞癌 (HCC) 的高 发病率 问题,并评估干扰素 (IFN) 治疗与核苷类似物 (NA) 对高危患者 HCC 发生的影响。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项回顾性 队列研究 研究对 368 名 HBV 相关 HCC 高风险患者进行,其中 120 名患者接受 IFN 治疗(联合或不联合 NA),248 名患者仅接受 NA 治疗。
elements_zh.methods: 患者入组并随访 5 年 治疗 期。使用统计分析对 IFN 组和 NAs 组之间的 HCC 发病率 进行监测和比较以确定显着性。
elements_zh.main_results: 治疗治疗5年后,IFN组的HCC 发病率为2.54%,而NAs组的发病率显着较高,为25.74%(P < 0.001)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为证据,表明在高危 HBV 患者中,与单独使用 NA 相比,基于 IFN 的治疗可显着降低 HCC 风险,强调了一种新的治疗方法。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果表明,基于 IFN 的治疗可能是减少 HBV 相关 HCC 高风险患者的 HCC 发病率 的更有效选择,可能为 治疗 指南和公共卫生策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其回顾性设计和潜在的混杂因素而受到限制,但由于 IFN 和 NA 组之间的清晰比较以及统计学上显着的结果,证据是强有力的。

news.title: Hepatitis B reactivation after switch to injectable treatment: rare, but proceed with caution - Aidsmap
news.rss_summary_html: Hepatitis B reactivation after switch to injectable treatment: rare, but proceed with caution  Aidsmap
news.excerpt_original: Hepatitis B reactivation after switch to injectable treatment: rare, but proceed with caution Aidsmap
news.priority_tier_reason: 可信机构来源或已成功抓获正文
news.content_title: Hepatitis B reactivation after switch to injectable treatment: rare, but proceed with caution
news.content: Hepatitis B reactivation after switch to injectable treatment: rare, but proceed with caution By Keith Alcorn Spain 19 November 2026 7 mins Although hepatitis B reactivation is rare after a switch to injectable cabotegravir / rilpivirine, people with HIV require careful monitoring before and after a switch to assess protection against hepatitis B and reactivation risks, studies presented at last week’s International Congress on Drug Therapy in HIV Infection (HIV Glasgow 2026) suggest. Cohort studies carried out in Spain and Italy found that rates of hepatitis B reactivation after switching to injectable cabotegravir / rilpivirine were low or non-existent. But the Italian study highlighted the risk of poor or non-existent immunity to hepatitis B despite vaccination. Three vaccinated people acquired hepatitis B during the study, although their infections were asymptomatic and detected only through tests for hepatitis B core antibody (anti-HBc) and surface antibody (anti-HBs). People with active chronic hepatitis B are not recommended to switch away from HIV treatment regimens containing tenofovir, which also suppresses hepatitis B. But for a much larger group of people – those with past exposure to hepatitis B or potential hidden, low-level infection – the risks and benefits of switching away from tenofovir have been less clear. Cohort studies in Europe report that approximately one-third of people with HIV have antibodies to hepatitis B core antigen (anti-HBc) but have no detectable hepatitis B surface antigen, showing that they have cleared hepatitis B infection or have a very low-level (occult) infection. Reactivation of hepatitis B due to an occult infection after the withdrawal of tenofovir is rare; a meta-analysis of studies that carried out regular HBV testing after tenofovir withdrawal found that nearly four cases occurred in every 100 person-years of follow-up. In most cases they are detected only by testing, but a US Veterans study found that one in four reactivations were accompanied by a flare-up of hepatitis that may lead to hospitalisation and liver damage. There seems to be no way to predict who will experience reactivation or how soon reactivation might occur after tenofovir withdrawal, emphasising the importance of regular monitoring for reactivation. Although the risk of reactivation appears low when taking dolutegravir / lamivudine, the currently available evidence is not sufficient to confirm that lamivudine protects against reactivation, Professor Anna Maria Geretti of the Royal Free Hospital, London, told the conference. More data is also needed on the risk of reactivation after switching to cabotegravir / rilpivirine. Two studies presented at HIV Glasgow provided further information. Glossary antibody A protein substance (immunoglobulin) produced by the immune system in response to a foreign organism. Many diagnostic tests for HIV detect the presence of antibodies to HIV in blood. hepatitis Inflammation of the liver, which can be caused by hepatitis viruses (A, B, C etc), alcohol or some drugs. If not treated, hepatitis can lead to hepatic fibrosis and/or cirrhosis. HIV Human immunodeficiency virus, the virus which causes AIDS. There are two variants: HIV-1, and HIV-2. HIV-1 is by far the most common worldwide. See ‘subtype’ for more information. on Abbreviation of a Latin term meaning every night. therapy Any form of treatment. Drugs, radiation, and psychiatric counselling are forms of therapy. In Spain, the RELATIVITY cohort followed 3349 people who switched to cabotegravir / rilpivirine before the end of 2024. Participants were followed for a median of 25 months after switching. The cohort was predominantly male (84%) and had been taking antiretroviral therapy for a median of nine years before switching. Half of all participants had been vaccinated against hepatitis B and had immunity, defined as testing positive for hepatitis B surface antibody and negative for hepatitis B core antibody. A further 12% had been vaccinated but did not have immunity. Seven percent had not been vaccinated and did not have evidence of exposure (no antibodies to HBc or HBs). Twelve per cent of participants had evidence of past HBV infection (anti-HBc and anti-HBs) while 3% had isolated anti-HBc without surface antibody, indicating either waning infection or extremely low-level HBV infection. Five study participants had active HBV (detectable hepatitis B surface antigen) at study entry. HBV serology was unavailable for 13% of participants. HBV serology was carried out during follow-up if acute infection was suspected but it was not carried out routinely for all participants. Isolated anti-HBc was detected in 115 people during a median 25 months of follow-up. No cases of clinically suspected reactivation with liver enzyme elevations were observed. Thirteen people had ALT increases but HBsAg was negative. HBV DNA testing was not done in all people with isolated anti-HBc so reactivation may be underestimated, Dr Luz Martin Carbonero of University Hospital La Paz, Madrid, noted. One person who had been vaccinated twice without developing antibody responses to hepatitis B acquired hepatitis B during the follow-up period. In Italy, the SCohoLART study followed 627 people who switched to injectable cabotegravir / rilpivirine, for a median of 2.7 years. Of these, 30% had previous HBV exposure, including 3% with isolated anti-HBc. Of the remainder, 50% had vaccine-induced immunity and 19% had no previous exposure or immunity. During the follow-up period, four people experienced HBV-related events. One participant with anti-HBc at the time of switching developed symptomatic reactivation of hepatitis B within three months of switching, leading to hospitalisation and resumption of tenofovir-containing treatment. Three vaccinated participants who were anti-HBc negative at the time of switching were found to have acquired HBV during follow-up. Two had no immunity despite vaccination; one had been vaccinated but had low levels of anti-HBs. HBV acquisition was detected by routine HBV serology. The findings underline the importance of checking immunisation status and antibody levels before switching to cabotegravir / rilpivirine or another regimen that doesn’t contain an HBV-active antiretroviral. Professor Anna Maria Geretti said that forthcoming British HIV Association guidelines will recommend the following management protocol for people with isolated anti-HBc measurements before switching: If anti-HBc positive but HBsAg-negative and HBV-DNA negative, give one dose of HBV vaccine and test for anti-HBs two weeks later. If anti-HBs levels are above 10 IU/ml, evaluate other risk factors for reactivation before switching. If anti-HBs levels are below 10 IU/ml, complete the HBV vaccine series before evaluating risk factors and before switching. Professor Geretti emphasised that although immunisation is advisable, inducing or boosting anti-HBs has not been shown to protect against reactivation, so it is important to assess the reactivation risk before switching. Re-vaccination is also advisable for people without anti-HBs, especially in circumstances where vaccination history is missing. A cross-sectional study of 679 people receiving HIV care in Buenos Aires, Argentina, found that information on HBV status was missing in over 40% of participants and 30% lacked protective immunity to HBV, either due to absence of vaccination or waning protection. news.content_original: Hepatitis B reactivation after switch to injectable treatment: rare, but proceed with caution By Keith Alcorn Spain 19 November 2026 7 mins Although hepatitis B reactivation is rare after a switch to injectable cabotegravir / rilpivirine, people with HIV require careful monitoring before and after a switch to assess protection against hepatitis B and reactivation risks, studies presented at last week’s International Congress on Drug Therapy in HIV Infection (HIV Glasgow 2026) suggest. Cohort studies carried out in Spain and Italy found that rates of hepatitis B reactivation after switching to injectable cabotegravir / rilpivirine were low or non-existent. But the Italian study highlighted the risk of poor or non-existent immunity to hepatitis B despite vaccination. Three vaccinated people acquired hepatitis B during the study, although their infections were asymptomatic and detected only through tests for hepatitis B core antibody (anti-HBc) and surface antibody (anti-HBs). People with active chronic hepatitis B are not recommended to switch away from HIV treatment regimens containing tenofovir, which also suppresses hepatitis B. But for a much larger group of people – those with past exposure to hepatitis B or potential hidden, low-level infection – the risks and benefits of switching away from tenofovir have been less clear. Cohort studies in Europe report that approximately one-third of people with HIV have antibodies to hepatitis B core antigen (anti-HBc) but have no detectable hepatitis B surface antigen, showing that they have cleared hepatitis B infection or have a very low-level (occult) infection. Reactivation of hepatitis B due to an occult infection after the withdrawal of tenofovir is rare; a meta-analysis of studies that carried out regular HBV testing after tenofovir withdrawal found that nearly four cases occurred in every 100 person-years of follow-up. In most cases they are detected only by testing, but a US Veterans study found that one in four reactivations were accompanied by a flare-up of hepatitis that may lead to hospitalisation and liver damage. There seems to be no way to predict who will experience reactivation or how soon reactivation might occur after tenofovir withdrawal, emphasising the importance of regular monitoring for reactivation. Although the risk of reactivation appears low when taking dolutegravir / lamivudine, the currently available evidence is not sufficient to confirm that lamivudine protects against reactivation, Professor Anna Maria Geretti of the Royal Free Hospital, London, told the conference. More data is also needed on the risk of reactivation after switching to cabotegravir / rilpivirine. Two studies presented at HIV Glasgow provided further information. Glossary antibody A protein substance (immunoglobulin) produced by the immune system in response to a foreign organism. Many diagnostic tests for HIV detect the presence of antibodies to HIV in blood. hepatitis Inflammation of the liver, which can be caused by hepatitis viruses (A, B, C etc), alcohol or some drugs. If not treated, hepatitis can lead to hepatic fibrosis and/or cirrhosis. HIV Human immunodeficiency virus, the virus which causes AIDS. There are two variants: HIV-1, and HIV-2. HIV-1 is by far the most common worldwide. See ‘subtype’ for more information. on Abbreviation of a Latin term meaning every night. therapy Any form of treatment. Drugs, radiation, and psychiatric counselling are forms of therapy. In Spain, the RELATIVITY cohort followed 3349 people who switched to cabotegravir / rilpivirine before the end of 2024. Participants were followed for a median of 25 months after switching. The cohort was predominantly male (84%) and had been taking antiretroviral therapy for a median of nine years before switching. Half of all participants had been vaccinated against hepatitis B and had immunity, defined as testing positive for hepatitis B surface antibody and negative for hepatitis B core antibody. A further 12% had been vaccinated but did not have immunity. Seven percent had not been vaccinated and did not have evidence of exposure (no antibodies to HBc or HBs). Twelve per cent of participants had evidence of past HBV infection (anti-HBc and anti-HBs) while 3% had isolated anti-HBc without surface antibody, indicating either waning infection or extremely low-level HBV infection. Five study participants had active HBV (detectable hepatitis B surface antigen) at study entry. HBV serology was unavailable for 13% of participants. HBV serology was carried out during follow-up if acute infection was suspected but it was not carried out routinely for all participants. Isolated anti-HBc was detected in 115 people during a median 25 months of follow-up. No cases of clinically suspected reactivation with liver enzyme elevations were observed. Thirteen people had ALT increases but HBsAg was negative. HBV DNA testing was not done in all people with isolated anti-HBc so reactivation may be underestimated, Dr Luz Martin Carbonero of University Hospital La Paz, Madrid, noted. One person who had been vaccinated twice without developing antibody responses to hepatitis B acquired hepatitis B during the follow-up period. In Italy, the SCohoLART study followed 627 people who switched to injectable cabotegravir / rilpivirine, for a median of 2.7 years. Of these, 30% had previous HBV exposure, including 3% with isolated anti-HBc. Of the remainder, 50% had vaccine-induced immunity and 19% had no previous exposure or immunity. During the follow-up period, four people experienced HBV-related events. One participant with anti-HBc at the time of switching developed symptomatic reactivation of hepatitis B within three months of switching, leading to hospitalisation and resumption of tenofovir-containing treatment. Three vaccinated participants who were anti-HBc negative at the time of switching were found to have acquired HBV during follow-up. Two had no immunity despite vaccination; one had been vaccinated but had low levels of anti-HBs. HBV acquisition was detected by routine HBV serology. The findings underline the importance of checking immunisation status and antibody levels before switching to cabotegravir / rilpivirine or another regimen that doesn’t contain an HBV-active antiretroviral. Professor Anna Maria Geretti said that forthcoming British HIV Association guidelines will recommend the following management protocol for people with isolated anti-HBc measurements before switching: If anti-HBc positive but HBsAg-negative and HBV-DNA negative, give one dose of HBV vaccine and test for anti-HBs two weeks later. If anti-HBs levels are above 10 IU/ml, evaluate other risk factors for reactivation before switching. If anti-HBs levels are below 10 IU/ml, complete the HBV vaccine series before evaluating risk factors and before switching. Professor Geretti emphasised that although immunisation is advisable, inducing or boosting anti-HBs has not been shown to protect against reactivation, so it is important to assess the reactivation risk before switching. Re-vaccination is also advisable for people without anti-HBs, especially in circumstances where vaccination history is missing. A cross-sectional study of 679 people receiving HIV care in Buenos Aires, Argentina, found that information on HBV status was missing in over 40% of participants and 30% lacked protective immunity to HBV, either due to absence of vaccination or waning protection. References Geretti AM. Hepatitis B 2-drug regimen and re-activation. International Congress on Drug Therapy in HIV Infection, Glasgow, 2026. Rueda MMA et al. HBV outcomes after switching to long-acting cabotegravir plus rilpivirine in the Spanish RELATIVITY cohort. International Congress on Drug Therapy in HIV Infection, Glasgow, abstract O35, 2026. Raccagni AR et al. Hepatitis B after switch to long-acting cabotegravir / rilpivirine: data from the SCohoLART study. International Congress on Drug Therapy in HIV Infection, Glasgow, abstract O36, 2026. Laufer N et al. Incomplete HBV serological documentation could mask unrecognized immunity gaps in people living with HIV receiving tenofovir-sparing antiretroviral therapy. International Congress on Drug Therapy in HIV Infection, Glasgow, abstract P505, 2026. analysis.time: Publication date: 2026-11-19. Event date: Not reported in the supplied evidence. Time range: Follow-up periods of 25 months in Spain and 2.7 years in Italy.
analysis.location_and_population: Affected population: People living with HIV, particularly those with past exposure to hepatitis B or potential hidden, low-level infection.
analysis.event: Hepatitis B reactivation was observed in some individuals after switching to injectable treatment regimens containing cabotegravir / rilpivirine. This was reported by studies presented at the International Congress on Drug Therapy in HIV Infection (HIV Glasgow 2026).
analysis.scale_impact_and_risk: In Spain, 115 people had isolated anti-HBc detected during follow-up, but no clinically suspected reactivation with liver enzyme elevations was observed. In Italy, four people experienced HBV-related events, including one case of symptomatic reactivation requiring hospitalisation. Reactivation risk is low but not negligible, and the evidence is insufficient to confirm protection with lamivudine.
analysis.response_status_and_uncertainty: Studies suggest that reactivation is rare, but regular monitoring is recommended. The evidence is not sufficient to confirm that lamivudine protects against reactivation. HBV DNA testing was not done in all people with isolated anti-HBc, potentially underestimating reactivation cases.

analysis.brief_en: This news report highlights the risk of hepatitis B reactivation in people living with HIV after switching to injectable treatment regimens containing cabotegravir / rilpivirine. Studies presented at the International Congress on Drug Therapy in HIV Infection (HIV Glasgow 2026) found that reactivation rates were low or non-existent in cohort studies conducted in Spain and Italy. In Spain, the RELATIVITY cohort followed 3349 individuals who switched to injectable treatment before the end of 2024, with a median follow-up of 25 months. No clinically suspected reactivation with liver enzyme elevations was observed, but 115 participants had isolated anti-HBc detected. In Italy, the SCohoLART study followed 627 individuals, with 30% having previous HBV exposure. Four HBV-related events were reported, including one case of symptomatic reactivation requiring hospitalisation. The report notes that the risk of reactivation appears low with dolutegravir / lamivudine, but the evidence is not sufficient to confirm protection. Regular monitoring is recommended due to the unpredictability of reactivation. HBV DNA testing was not routinely performed, which may have underestimated reactivation cases.

news.content_zh: 本新闻报道强调了艾滋病毒感染者改用含有卡博特韦/利匹韦林的 治疗 注射疗法后乙型肝炎重新激活的风险。在国际艾滋病毒感染药物治疗大会(HIV 格拉斯哥 2026 年)上发表的研究发现,在西班牙和意大利进行的 队列研究 研究中,重新激活率很低或不存在。在西班牙,RELATIVITY 队列研究 对 2024 年底前改用注射剂 治疗 的 3349 人进行了跟踪,中位随访时间为 25 个月。没有观察到临床上怀疑的肝酶升高导致的再激活,但 115 名参与者检测到了分离的抗 HBc。在意大利,SCohoLART 研究对 627 人进行了跟踪调查,其中 30% 的人曾接触过乙肝病毒。报告了四起 HBV 相关事件,其中包括一例需要住院治疗的症状再激活病例。报告指出,多替拉韦/拉米夫定的再激活风险似乎较低,但证据不足以证实保护作用。由于重新激活的不可预测性,建议定期监测。没有常规进行 HBV DNA 检测,这可能低估了病毒再激活病例。

As efforts to improve diagnosis and treatment continue, this sector is expected to witness consistent growth, driven by both medical innovation and public health initiatives. Let’s explore the market size, key growth factors, dominant regional players, and emerging trends shaping the future of chronic hepatitis B treatment. Understanding the Market Size and Growth Projections for Chronic Hepatitis B The chronic hepatitis B market has shown a steady upward trend in recent years. It is projected to grow from $3.93 billion in 2025 to $4.1 billion in 2026, representing a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 4.2%. This increase during the historical period has been largely propelled by enhanced hepatitis B screening efforts, broader access to antiviral medications, heightened awareness of liver disease complications, wider usage of nucleos(t)ide analogs, and the establishment of long-term disease monitoring protocols. This forecasted growth is supported by rising investments in next-generation HBV therapies, a growing preference for treatment regimens that require shorter durations, ongoing development of therapeutic vaccines, and intensified efforts to eliminate viral reservoirs. Additional trends expected to influence the market include increased adoption of long-term antiviral treatments, advancements in functional cure strategies, heightened emphasis on early detection and disease monitoring, expansion of immune-modulating therapies, and stronger patient adherence initiatives. What Chronic Hepatitis B Means and Its Medical Impact Chronic hepatitis B is a persistent infection caused by the hepatitis B virus (HBV) lasting longer than six months. It can lead to serious liver complications, including liver damage, failure, or cancer. The condition often remains symptomless for many years but can be diagnosed through blood testing and managed effectively using antiviral drugs combined with regular health monitoring. Hepatitis B is a liver infection caused by the virus, which can be prevented through vaccination programs. However, low vaccination coverage in many low- and middle-income countries results in higher transmission rates, as large populations remain vulnerable. This increase in infection rates boosts the demand for diagnostic testing and treatment solutions. For instance, a report released by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) in June 2024 highlighted that raising global hepatitis B vaccination coverage to 90% and improving treatment availability to 80% could prevent 26 million new infections and save 9 million lives between 2022 and 2050. In 2022 alone, there were 1.2 million new HBV infections reported. This significant disease burden continues to fuel the chronic hepatitis B market’s expansion. news.content: Sinä päätät henkilötiedoistasi Sivustomme STT Info käyttää evästeitä. Klikkaa "Hyväksy kaikki" nähdäksesi kaiken sisällön sivustolla. Valitse "Hylkää kaikki", jos haluat rajoittaa evästeiden käytön vain välttämättömiin. Jos haluat tehdä tarkempia valintoja, klikkaa "Näytä tiedot". Lue lisää evästeistä Hylkää kaikki Hyväksy kaikki Tiedotteet Tilaa tiedotteita Julkaisijat Tietoa palvelusta Osta kertatiedote Kirjaudu Study provides additional evidence on hepatitis D virus prevalence in people without hepatitis B 18.11.2026 10:59:27 EET | HUS | Press release Share The established medical understanding has been that hepatitis D virus infection cannot occur without a simultaneous hepatitis B infection. The results from a study conducted by HUS and the University of Helsinki suggest that hepatitis D virus infection can occur without a simultaneous hepatitis B infection. Researcher Jussi Hepojoki, specialist in clinical microbiology Hanna Jarva and specialist in clinical microbiology Satu Kurkela Hanna Raijas-Turva HUS Hepatitis D (HDV) is a satellite virus, which means that it needs a helper virus for transmission. The current understanding is that HDV cannot be transmitted without a simultaneous hepatitis B (HBV) infection. However, this view has been challenged in some recent studies. A study conducted by HUS and the University of Helsinki provided additional evidence on the prevalence of HDV without an HBV infection. “Based on the results, we cannot conclude that HDV can occur without HBV, but the evidence we gained is very interesting. If it can be demonstrated that HDV can occur without HBV, further research will be needed to determine the clinical significance of HDV without HBV,” explains Satu Kurkela, head of division and a specialist in clinical microbiology at HUS. Hepatitis B, C and D are blood-borne infections. Hepatitis B and C can cause severe liver diseases if the infections become chronic. The current understanding is that an HDV infection predisposes an HBV carrier to severe symptoms of the disease. More research needed on other possible helper viruses The study analyzed 2,121 samples of blood serum and plasma from 1,996 patients. The samples analyzed were residual specimens from samples sent to the HUS Virology and Immunology laboratory for other diagnostic purposes in 2021 and 2022. In the analyzed samples, 20 patients were positive for HDV antibodies, and 17 of them did not have a simultaneous HBV infection. One patient was diagnosed with an active HDV infection without an HBV infection. This patient was diagnosed with hepatitis C (HCV). “This finding was especially interesting, because there is previous evidence suggesting that HCV may be a possible HDV helper virus. Our finding does not provide certainty on the matter, and more research is needed,” says Jussi Hepojoki, a researcher at the University of Helsinki. The helper virus defines which cells HDV can penetrate in the body. “Information on what other helper viruses HDV can use would be virologically significant. Especially, as we know that HDV may significantly aggravate HBV infection.” First data on HDV prevalence in Finland The study provided information on the prevalence of HDV in Finland for the first time. In the analyzed material, the prevalence was about one percent. “This does not mean that one percent of Finns carry HDV, but it provides initial information on the occurrence of the virus in Finland,” says Hanna Jarva, chief physician and specialist in clinical microbiology at HUS. Currently, HDV antibodies are only examined from people who have been diagnosed with HBV. If it is true that HDV can also occur without HBV, some HDV infections may remain undetected. “Hopefully, future research will show if this really is the case, and, if so, what its clinical significance is.” The study was published in the Journal of Clinical Virology. Research article: Further evidence of hepatitis D occurring in the absence of hepatitis B In university hospitals, research is part of the treatment: new findings make treatment practises more efficient and help target treatments correctly. We work in close collaboration with the University of Helsinki and other universities, and we publish about 3000 peer-reviewed research articles annually. Today’s research provides better care tomorrow. news.title_zh: 研究提供了在没有乙型肝炎的人群中存在丁型肝炎病毒 患病率 的额外证据 - STT Info
news.source_body_en: A study conducted by HUS and the University of Helsinki challenges the established understanding that hepatitis D virus (HDV) infection cannot occur without a simultaneous hepatitis B (HBV) infection. The research analyzed 2,121 blood serum and plasma samples from 1,996 patients, revealing that 20 patients were positive for HDV antibodies, with 17 not having HBV infection. One patient was diagnosed with an active HDV infection without HBV, and the prevalence of HDV in the analyzed material was about one percent. The findings suggest that HDV may use other helper viruses, such as hepatitis C virus (HCV), which could have virological significance. However, the study does not confirm that HDV can occur without HBV, and further research is needed to determine the clinical implications. The study was published in the Journal of Clinical Virology and provides the first data on HDV prevalence in Finland.
